# OPTIMUS HeatRoute — комплект передачи

Сложная территория — оптимальное подключение.

Сервис автоматически строит варианты новой тепловой сети, рассчитывает расходы, диаметры и стоимость, показывает результат на карте и выгружает GeoJSON.

## Результат

**17/17 подключений. Строительство 431 306 579,53 ₽. Новая сеть 3 520,886 м. Штраф 0 ₽. S = 22,639241120.**

Стоимость уменьшена относительно предыдущей полностью подключённой схемы на 4 731 165,79 ₽, длина — на 54,712 м. Глобальный минимум не доказан.

## С чего начать

1. `START-HERE.md` — запуск на Ubuntu Server 22.04 и docker-compose 1.29.2.
2. `results/result.geojson` — все три варианта; `results/best-variant.geojson` — лучший; `results/result.report.json` — протокол.
3. `visualization/result.html` — интерактивная карта, открывается без сервера.
4. `presentation/` — презентация на 8 слайдах, PDF и сведения для конкурсной подачи.
5. `docs/COMPLIANCE.md` и `docs/VALIDATION.md` — статус требований и проверок.

## Состав

`backend/` — исходники, интерфейс и тесты. `release/optimus-heatroute.jar` — готовый сервис. `Dockerfile` собирает исходники и выполняет тесты. `docker-compose.yml` запускает приложение и PostgreSQL/PostGIS. Отдельная конфигурация `compose.prebuilt.yml` запускает готовый JAR.

`data/corrected.geojson` — фактически рассчитанный вход. `data/input-provenance.json` — отличие от ранее переданного файла. `references/` — неизменённые документы организатора и прежний набор. `evidence/` — протоколы проверок. `full-project.txt` — текстовые исходники проекта. `SHA256SUMS` — контрольные суммы поставки.

## Границы подтверждения

Основной режим — cost: выбирается допустимое место прямого ввода в собственный ОКС с учётом стоимости. Результат 17/17 относится к нему. В позднем приложении §2.2 и разъяснении №3 есть формулировка «от ближайшей к точке границы полигона». Режим cost не проверяет глобальный геометрический минимум до границы; формальное соответствие этому пункту не подтверждено. Сохранён отдельный режим nearest.

Целевой стек: Ubuntu 22.04, Java 11, Spring Boot 2.6.3, PostgreSQL/PostGIS и docker-compose 1.29.2. Наличие конфигурации не означает пройденную инфраструктурную приёмку: фактический запуск Ubuntu/Docker/PostGIS в среде подготовки не выполнен. Остальные проверки перечислены в docs/VALIDATION.md.

# Запуск на Ubuntu Server 22.04

Цель: Ubuntu Server 22.04 x86_64, 16 ГБ ОЗУ. Рекомендуется от 30 ГБ свободного диска; крупные файлы потребуют больше. Первый запуск требует Интернета для пакетов, Maven и образов Docker.

## 1. Распаковать архив

```bash
unzip OPTIMUS-HeatRoute-Final.zip
cd OPTIMUS-HeatRoute
find . -name '*.sh' -exec chmod +x {} +
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

## 2. Установить зависимости на новом сервере

```bash
bash scripts/install-ubuntu.sh
```

Устанавливаются Docker Engine 24.0.9 и docker-compose 1.29.2. Существующий Docker не удаляется и не заменяется. Для обязательного старого Compose используется отдельный стенд с совместимой версией Engine; подробности в docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.

## 3. Собрать и запустить

```bash
sudo env OPTIMUS_CONTEST=1 bash deploy.sh
sudo docker-compose ps
curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health
```

Dockerfile собирает исходники с тестами, включая расчёт 17 целей. Сборка занимает несколько минут. Java и Maven на хосте не нужны: они входят в образы. Первый запуск создаёт `.env` со случайным паролем БД.

Интерфейс: http://127.0.0.1:8080 . Swagger: http://127.0.0.1:8080/swagger-ui.html . Готовая карта: http://127.0.0.1:8080/result-viewer.html .

## 4. Открыть из Windows

Для отдельного Ubuntu-сервера в PowerShell (замените логин и IP):

```powershell
ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 ubuntu@192.168.1.100
```

Для VirtualBox с NAT сначала пробросьте гостевой SSH-порт 22 на порт хоста 2222:

```powershell
ssh -p 2222 -L 8080:127.0.0.1:8080 ubuntu@127.0.0.1
```

Оставьте SSH-окно открытым и зайдите на http://localhost:8080 в Windows. На Ubuntu должен работать OpenSSH Server; при необходимости: `sudo apt-get install -y openssh-server`.

## 5. Выполнить расчёт

«Открыть конкурсный датасет» → «Рассчитать варианты» → дождаться 17/17 → выбрать вариант → «Скачать GeoJSON». Кнопка протокола показывает объяснения и диагностику. Полный сценарий выступления: docs/DEMO.md.

## 6. Сохранить приёмочный протокол на Ubuntu

```bash
sudo bash scripts/acceptance-contest.sh
```

Проверяется среда и PostGIS, выполняется новый HTTP-расчёт, проверяется GeoJSON и полный охват, создаётся карта. Затем запускаются 50 клиентов на малых синтетических заданиях. Протоколы: evidence/acceptance-latest и evidence/contest.

## 7. Управление

```bash
sudo bash deploy.sh status
sudo bash deploy.sh logs
sudo bash deploy.sh stop
```

Тома БД и расчётов сохраняются. Для повторного запуска выполните шаг 3. Сохраните `.env`; не используйте `down -v`, если данные нужны.

## Быстрый запуск готового JAR

```bash
sudo env OPTIMUS_CONTEST=1 bash deploy.sh prebuilt
```

Этот вариант не пересобирает Java-код. Основная конфигурация выше собирает проект из исходников, как предусмотрено ТЗ. Без Docker при установленной Java 11: `bash start.sh --local`; это отдельный файловый профиль без PostgreSQL.

package com.heatroute.api;

import com.heatroute.application.Jobs;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import com.heatroute.persistence.JobStore;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.core.io.FileSystemResource;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MultipartFile;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1")
public class Api {
  private final Jobs jobs;
  private final JobStore store;

  public Api(Jobs jobs, JobStore store) {
    this.jobs = jobs;
    this.store = store;
  }

  @GetMapping("/capabilities")
  public Map<String, Object> capabilities() {
    return Map.of(
        "name",
        "OPTIMUS HeatRoute",
        "version",
        "2.1.0",
        "entryPolicy", com.heatroute.constraints.EntryPolicy.name(),
        "srid",
        32637,
        "depth",
        false,
        "reconstruction",
        false,
        "maxInputBytes",
        Jobs.MAX_INPUT,
        "maxResultBytes",
        Jobs.MAX_OUTPUT);
  }

  @GetMapping("/catalog")
  public Object catalog() {
    return DiameterCatalog.ALL;
  }

  @GetMapping("/calculations")
  public Object list() {
    return store.list();
  }

  @PostMapping(value = "/calculations", consumes = "multipart/form-data")
  public ResponseEntity<?> create(@RequestPart("file") MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
    try (InputStream in = file.getInputStream()) {
      return ResponseEntity.status(201)
          .body(
              jobs.create(
                  in, Optional.ofNullable(file.getOriginalFilename()).orElse("dataset.geojson")));
    }
  }

  @GetMapping("/calculations/{id}")
  public Object get(@PathVariable UUID id) {
    return store.get(id.toString());
  }

  @PostMapping("/calculations/{id}/run")
  public ResponseEntity<?> run(@PathVariable UUID id) {
    jobs.start(id.toString());
    return ResponseEntity.accepted().body(store.get(id.toString()));
  }

  @GetMapping("/calculations/{id}/result")
  public ResponseEntity<?> result(@PathVariable UUID id) throws IOException {
    if (!store.get(id.toString()).get("status").equals("COMPLETED"))
      throw new IllegalStateException("Result is not ready");
    Path p = jobs.root.resolve(id + ".result.geojson");
    return ResponseEntity.ok()
        .contentType(MediaType.parseMediaType("application/geo+json"))
        .contentLength(Files.size(p))
        .header("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename=optimus-" + id + ".geojson")
        .body(new FileSystemResource(p));
  }

  @PostMapping(value = "/datasets/audit", consumes = "multipart/form-data")
  public Object audit(@RequestPart("file") MultipartFile file) throws IOException {
    Map<String, Integer> counts = new TreeMap<>();
    List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
    try (InputStream in = file.getInputStream()) {
      long n =
          new GeoJsonInput()
              .stream(
                  in,
                  f -> {
                    counts.merge(f.type, 1, Integer::sum);
                    if (f.type.equals("restriction")
                        && !GeoJsonInput.RULES.contains(f.restriction)
                        && warnings.size() < 100)
                      warnings.add(
                          "Unsupported optional restriction: " + f.id + " / " + f.restriction);
                  });
      return Map.of(
          "featureCount",
          n,
          "objectTypes",
          counts,
          "warnings",
          warnings,
          "valid",
          counts.getOrDefault("oks_connection_point", 0) > 0
              && counts.getOrDefault("heat_network", 0) > 0,
          "note",
          "Structure and geometry checked; route feasibility is evaluated by calculation");
    }
  }
}

package com.heatroute.api;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.http.*;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.web.multipart.MaxUploadSizeExceededException;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class Errors {
  @ExceptionHandler({IOException.class, IllegalArgumentException.class})
  public ResponseEntity<?> invalid(Exception e) {
    return ResponseEntity.unprocessableEntity()
        .body(Map.of("detail", String.valueOf(e.getMessage())));
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(NoSuchElementException.class)
  public ResponseEntity<?> missing(Exception e) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(404).body(Map.of("detail", "Calculation not found"));
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(IllegalStateException.class)
  public ResponseEntity<?> conflict(Exception e) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(409).body(Map.of("detail", String.valueOf(e.getMessage())));
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(MaxUploadSizeExceededException.class)
  public ResponseEntity<?> limit() {
    return ResponseEntity.status(413).body(Map.of("detail", "File exceeds 3 GiB"));
  }
}

===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/application/EntryCertificate.java BYTES 3171 SHA256 a07138646becad5242369a1bc613fb744fbea96cdd7ac066da9caa47221c17d9 =====
package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;

/**
 * A sufficient, deliberately narrow impossibility test for the required final straight entry.
 * Between consecutive building intersections separated by D, distance to the building is at most
 * min(t,D-t), hence at most D/2. If D/2 < required clearance, no upstream bend can stand in this
 * interval. A tie directly in the interval is checked separately.
 */
public final class EntryCertificate {
  public static Map<String, Object> prove(
      Snapshot s, Feature owner, Feature target, Coordinate boundary, double clearance) {
    Coordinate end = target.geometry().getCoordinate();
    double nearest = end.distance(boundary);
    if (nearest < 1e-5) return null;
    Geometry rings = owner.geometry().getBoundary();
    for (int k = 0; k < rings.getNumGeometries(); k++) {
      Coordinate[] cs = rings.getGeometryN(k).getCoordinates();
      for (int i = 1; i < cs.length; i++) {
        Coordinate q = new LineSegment(cs[i - 1], cs[i]).closestPoint(end);
        if (Math.abs(q.distance(end) - nearest) < 1e-5 && q.distance(boundary) > 1e-4) return null;
      }
    }
    Envelope e = owner.envelope;
    double extent = Math.hypot(e.getWidth(), e.getHeight()) + 100;
    Coordinate far =
        new Coordinate(
            boundary.x + (boundary.x - end.x) / nearest * extent,
            boundary.y + (boundary.y - end.y) / nearest * extent);
    LineString ray = Metric.line(boundary, far);
    LengthIndexedLine index = new LengthIndexedLine(ray);
    Geometry intersections = ray.intersection(owner.geometry());
    double next = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    for (int k = 0; k < intersections.getNumGeometries(); k++) {
      Geometry part = intersections.getGeometryN(k);
      double lo = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, hi = 0;
      for (Coordinate c : part.getCoordinates()) {
        double t = index.project(c);
        lo = Math.min(lo, t);
        hi = Math.max(hi, t);
      }
      if (hi <= 1e-5) continue;
      if (lo <= 1e-5 && part.getLength() > 1e-4) next = 0;
      else next = Math.min(next, lo);
    }
    if (!Double.isFinite(next) || next / 2 >= clearance - .01) return null;
    LineString interval = Metric.line(boundary, index.extractPoint(Math.max(next, 1e-5)));
    Envelope query = interval.getEnvelopeInternal();
    query.expandBy(.10);
    for (Feature f : s.nearby(query))
      if (f.type.equals("heat_network") && f.geometry().distance(interval) <= .10) return null;
    return Map.of(
        "rule",
        "UNIQUE_NEAREST_STRAIGHT_ENTRY_BLOCKED",
        "buildingId",
        owner.id,
        "freeRayLengthM",
        next,
        "clearanceUpperBoundM",
        next / 2,
        "requiredClearanceM",
        clearance,
        "existingNetworkInEntryInterval",
        false,
        "argument",
        "Every possible upstream bend in the entry interval violates the own-building clearance; no"
            + " direct tie exists in that interval");
  }

  private EntryCertificate() {}
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.export.GeoJsonExporter;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import com.heatroute.persistence.JobStore;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import javax.annotation.PreDestroy;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.boot.context.event.ApplicationReadyEvent;
import org.springframework.context.event.EventListener;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

@Service
public class Jobs {
  public static final long MAX_INPUT = 3L * 1024 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_OUTPUT = 500L * 1024 * 1024;
  public final Path root;
  private final JobStore store;
  private final ThreadPoolExecutor workers =
      new ThreadPoolExecutor(2, 2, 0, TimeUnit.SECONDS, new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(50));
  private final Semaphore uploads = new Semaphore(2, true),
      largeCalculations = new Semaphore(1, true);

  public Jobs(JobStore store, @Value("${optimus.storage}") String root) throws IOException {
    this.store = store;
    this.root = Path.of(root);
    Files.createDirectories(this.root);
  }

  public Map<String, Object> create(InputStream input, String filename) throws IOException {
    uploads.acquireUninterruptibly();
    String id = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
    Path file = root.resolve(id + ".input.geojson");
    try {
      MessageDigest digest;
      try { digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); }
      catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) { throw new IllegalStateException(e); }
      long bytes = 0;
      try (OutputStream out = Files.newOutputStream(file)) {
        byte[] buffer = new byte[1024 * 1024];
        int n;
        while ((n = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
          bytes += n;
          if (bytes > MAX_INPUT) throw new IOException("Input exceeds 3 GiB");
          out.write(buffer, 0, n);
          digest.update(buffer, 0, n);
        }
      }
      Map<String,Integer> counts = new TreeMap<>();
      List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
      long count;
      try (InputStream in = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
        count = new GeoJsonInput().stream(in, f -> {
          counts.merge(f.type, 1, Integer::sum);
          if (f.type.equals("restriction") && !GeoJsonInput.RULES.contains(f.restriction) && warnings.size() < 100)
            warnings.add("Unsupported optional restriction: " + f.id + " / " + f.restriction);
        });
      }
      if (counts.getOrDefault("oks_connection_point",0)==0 || counts.getOrDefault("heat_network",0)==0)
        throw new IOException("Required heat_network and oks_connection_point");
      StringBuilder hash = new StringBuilder();
      for (byte b : digest.digest()) hash.append(String.format("%02x",b));
      Map<String, Object> state = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      state.put("inputSha256", hash.toString());
      state.put("audit", Map.of("featureCount",count,"objectTypes",counts,"warnings",warnings,"valid",true));
      state.put("id", id);
      state.put("filename", filename);
      state.put("created", Instant.now().toString());
      state.put("status", "IMPORTED");
      state.put("inputBytes", bytes);
      store.save(id, state);
      return state;
    } catch (Exception e) {
      Files.deleteIfExists(file);
      throw e;
    } finally {
      uploads.release();
    }
  }

  public synchronized void start(String id) {
    Map<String, Object> state = store.get(id);
    if (!Set.of("IMPORTED", "FAILED").contains(state.get("status")))
      throw new IllegalStateException("Already running or completed");
    state.put("status", "QUEUED");
    state.remove("error");
    store.save(id, state);
    try {
      workers.execute(() -> calculate(id, state));
    } catch (RejectedExecutionException e) {
      state.put("status", "IMPORTED");
      store.save(id, state);
      throw new IllegalStateException("Queue full; retry later");
    }
  }

  private void calculate(String id, Map<String, Object> state) {
    Path tmp = root.resolve(id + ".result.tmp");
    boolean large = ((Number) state.get("inputBytes")).longValue() > 256L * 1024 * 1024;
    if (large) largeCalculations.acquireUninterruptibly();
    try {
      state.put("status", "RUNNING");
      state.put("progress", Map.of("phase", "VALIDATING"));
      store.save(id, state);
      try (var snapshot =
          new GeoJsonInput()
              .read(
                  Files.newInputStream(root.resolve(id + ".input.geojson")),
                  root.resolve(id + ".geometry.spool"))) {
        for (var f : snapshot.features)
          if (f.type.equals("restriction") && !GeoJsonInput.RULES.contains(f.restriction))
            snapshot.warnings.add(
                "Unsupported optional restriction " + f.id + ": " + f.restriction);
        store.dataset(id, snapshot);
        var result =
            new Optimizer(
                    snapshot,
                    p -> {
                      state.put("progress", p);
                      store.save(id, state);
                    })
                .solve();
        try (OutputStream out =
            new GeoJsonExporter.Limited(Files.newOutputStream(tmp), MAX_OUTPUT)) {
          new GeoJsonExporter().write(snapshot, result.variants, out);
        }
        Files.move(
            tmp,
            root.resolve(id + ".result.geojson"),
            StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,
            StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
        state.put("status", "COMPLETED");
        result.report.put("inputSha256", state.get("inputSha256"));
        state.put("report", result.report);
        state.put("finished", Instant.now().toString());
        store.save(id, state);
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      try {
        Files.deleteIfExists(tmp);
      } catch (IOException ignored) {
      }
      state.put("status", "FAILED");
      state.put("error", e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
      store.save(id, state);
    } finally {
      if (large) largeCalculations.release();
    }
  }

  @EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class)
  public void recover() {
    for (var state : store.list())
      if (Set.of("RUNNING", "QUEUED").contains(state.get("status"))) {
        state.put("status", "FAILED");
        state.put("error", "Interrupted by restart; resubmit calculation");
        store.save(state.get("id").toString(), state);
      }
  }

  @PreDestroy
  public void close() {
    workers.shutdown();
  }
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.TreeHydraulics;
import com.heatroute.tiein.TieInPlanner;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;

/** Monotone local improvement of a complete network; every move preserves its target set. */
public final class NetworkRefiner {
  private final Snapshot snapshot;
  private final Optimizer optimizer;
  private final TieInPlanner tie;
  private final TreeHydraulics hydraulic = new TreeHydraulics();
  private final Consumer<Map<String,Object>> progress;
  private final Map<Component,BigDecimal> scores = new IdentityHashMap<>();
  private final Map<String,List<Component>> groupCache = new HashMap<>();
  private long checks, accepted;
  private static final BigDecimal MIN_GAIN = new BigDecimal("0.000000001");

  public NetworkRefiner(Snapshot snapshot, Optimizer optimizer,
                        Consumer<Map<String,Object>> progress) {
    this.snapshot=snapshot; this.optimizer=optimizer; this.progress=progress;
    tie=new TieInPlanner(snapshot);
  }

  public Map<String,Object> refine(Variant network, int seed) {
    optimizer.score(network);
    BigDecimal before=network.score, costBefore=network.construction(), lengthBefore=network.length;
    Set<String> coverage=coverage(network);
    long started=System.nanoTime(), firstCheck=checks, firstAccepted=accepted;
    // Coverage-repair and beam-assembled candidates also receive economic merging.
    optimizer.merge(network);
    optimizer.score(network);
    for(int round=0; round<2; round++) {
      BigDecimal previous=network.score;
      List<Component> ordered=new ArrayList<>(network.components);
      ordered.sort(Comparator.comparing((Component c)->optimizer.group(c))
          .thenComparing(c->c.root.key()));
      int done=0;
      for(Component old:ordered) {
        List<Component> rest=new ArrayList<>(network.components); rest.remove(old);
        Component best=shortcuts(old,rest);
        best=retie(best,rest);
        best=moveHub(best,rest);
        best=bends(best,rest);
        best=shortcuts(best,rest);
        if(best!=old) {
          network.components.set(network.components.indexOf(old),best);
          accepted++;
        }
        progress.accept(Map.of("phase","REFINING","seed",seed,"round",round+1,
            "componentsDone",++done,"componentsTotal",ordered.size(),"checks",checks));
      }
      optimizer.score(network);
      if(round==0) repartition(network);
      optimizer.merge(network);
      optimizer.score(network);
      if(previous.subtract(network.score).compareTo(MIN_GAIN)<=0) break;
    }
    if(!coverage.equals(coverage(network))) throw new IllegalStateException("Refinement changed coverage");
    if(network.score.compareTo(before)>0) throw new IllegalStateException("Refinement worsened score");
    new SolutionVerifier(snapshot).verify(network);
    Map<String,Object> result=new LinkedHashMap<>();
    result.put("seed",seed); result.put("beforeScore",before); result.put("afterScore",network.score);
    result.put("constructionBefore",costBefore); result.put("constructionAfter",network.construction());
    result.put("lengthBefore",lengthBefore); result.put("lengthAfter",network.length);
    result.put("candidateChecks",checks-firstCheck); result.put("acceptedMoves",accepted-firstAccepted);
    result.put("coveragePreserved",true); result.put("elapsedMillis",(System.nanoTime()-started)/1000000);
    result.put("method","Economic merging; route shortcuts; tie-in and chamber relocation; bend relaxation; target regrouping");
    progress.accept(Map.of("phase","REFINED","seed",seed,"score",network.score,
        "constructionCost",network.construction(),"length",network.length));
    scores.clear(); groupCache.clear();
    return result;
  }

  private Set<String> coverage(Variant v) {
    Set<String> targets=new TreeSet<>();
    for(Component c:v.components) for(Branch b:c.branches)
      if(!targets.add(b.target.key)) throw new IllegalStateException("Duplicate refined target");
    return targets;
  }

  private BigDecimal score(Component c) {
    return scores.computeIfAbsent(c,optimizer::componentScore);
  }

  private Component resized(Root root, Coordinate hub, LineString trunk, List<Branch> branches) {
    try { return hydraulic.size(root,hub,trunk,branches); }
    catch(IllegalArgumentException ex) { return null; }
  }

  private Component choose(Component best,Component candidate,List<Component> rest) {
    if(candidate==null) return best;
    checks++;
    if(!optimizer.valid(candidate) || !optimizer.compatible(candidate,rest)) return best;
    return score(best).subtract(score(candidate)).compareTo(MIN_GAIN)>0 ? candidate : best;
  }

  private LineString line(Component c,int index) { return index<0?c.trunk:c.branches.get(index).line; }

  private Component replaceLine(Component c,int index,LineString changed) {
    if(index<0) return resized(c.root,c.hub,changed,c.branches);
    List<Branch> leaves=new ArrayList<>(c.branches); Branch old=leaves.get(index);
    leaves.set(index,new Branch(old.target,changed,old.dn));
    return resized(c.root,c.hub,c.trunk,leaves);
  }

  private Component shortcuts(Component c,List<Component> rest) {
    for(int index=c.trunk==null?0:-1;index<c.branches.size();index++) {
      boolean changed=true;
      while(changed) {
        changed=false; Coordinate[] points=line(c,index).getCoordinates();
        Component best=c;
        for(int width=points.length-1;width>=2;width--)
          for(int a=0;a+width<points.length;a++) {
            int b=a+width; List<Coordinate> out=new ArrayList<>();
            for(int k=0;k<=a;k++) out.add(points[k]);
            for(int k=b;k<points.length;k++) out.add(points[k]);
            best=choose(best,replaceLine(c,index,Metric.line(out.toArray(new Coordinate[0]))),rest);
          }
        if(best!=c) { c=best; changed=true; }
      }
    }
    return c;
  }

  private Component bends(Component c,List<Component> rest) {
    for(double step:new double[]{16,4,1,.25})
      for(int index=c.trunk==null?0:-1;index<c.branches.size();index++)
        for(int i=1;i<line(c,index).getNumPoints()-1;i++) {
          Coordinate[] original=line(c,index).getCoordinates(); Component best=c;
          List<Coordinate> positions=new ArrayList<>();
          positions.add(new LineSegment(original[i-1],original[i+1]).closestPoint(original[i]));
          for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++) for(int dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)
            if(dx!=0||dy!=0) positions.add(new Coordinate(original[i].x+dx*step,original[i].y+dy*step));
          for(Coordinate at:positions) {
            Coordinate[] points=original.clone(); points[i]=at;
            if(points[i-1].distance(at)<1e-5 || points[i+1].distance(at)<1e-5) continue;
            LineString changed=Metric.line(points);
            if(changed.getLength()>=line(c,index).getLength()-1e-7) continue;
            best=choose(best,replaceLine(c,index,changed),rest);
          }
          c=best;
        }
    return c;
  }

  private Component hubAt(Component c,Coordinate point) {
    Coordinate[] trunk=c.trunk.getCoordinates().clone(); trunk[trunk.length-1]=point;
    List<Branch> branches=new ArrayList<>();
    for(Branch b:c.branches) {
      Coordinate[] leaf=b.line.getCoordinates().clone(); leaf[0]=point;
      branches.add(new Branch(b.target,Metric.line(leaf),b.dn));
    }
    return resized(c.root,point,Metric.line(trunk),branches);
  }

  private Component moveHub(Component c,List<Component> rest) {
    if(c.trunk==null) return c;
    for(double step:new double[]{32,16,8,4,2,1,.25})
      for(int round=0;round<2;round++) {
        Component best=c;
        for(int dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++) for(int dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)
          if(dx!=0||dy!=0) best=choose(best,hubAt(c,new Coordinate(c.hub.x+dx*step,c.hub.y+dy*step)),rest);
        if(best==c) break;
        c=best;
      }
    return c;
  }

  private Component rootAt(Component c,Root root) {
    LineString path=c.trunk==null?c.branches.get(0).line:c.trunk;
    Coordinate[] points=path.getCoordinates().clone(); points[0]=root.point;
    if(c.trunk!=null) return resized(root,c.hub,Metric.line(points),c.branches);
    return resized(root,null,null,List.of(new Branch(c.branches.get(0).target,Metric.line(points),50)));
  }

  private Component retie(Component c,List<Component> rest) {
    LineString path=c.trunk==null?c.branches.get(0).line:c.trunk;
    Coordinate anchor=path.getCoordinateN(1);
    Map<String,Root> roots=new TreeMap<>();
    // Project the first free route vertex, not only the remote consumer.
    for(Feature network:snapshot.nearestNetworks(anchor,8)) {
      LineString geometry=(LineString)network.geometry(); LengthIndexedLine index=new LengthIndexedLine(geometry);
      for(double base:new double[]{index.project(anchor),index.project(c.root.point)})
        for(double shift:new double[]{-64,-32,-16,-8,-4,-1,0,1,4,8,16,32,64}) {
          Coordinate at=index.extractPoint(Math.max(0,Math.min(geometry.getLength(),base+shift)));
          for(Root root:tie.candidatesAt(at)) roots.put(root.key(),root);
        }
    }
    Component best=c;
    for(Root root:roots.values()) best=choose(best,rootAt(c,root),rest);
    return best;
  }

  private LineString combined(Component c,Branch b) {
    if(c.trunk==null) return b.line;
    List<Coordinate> points=new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(c.trunk.getCoordinates()));
    Coordinate[] leaf=b.line.getCoordinates();
    for(int i=1;i<leaf.length;i++) points.add(leaf[i]);
    return Metric.line(points.toArray(new Coordinate[0]));
  }

  private List<Component> alternatives(List<Feature> targets,Component a,Component b) {
    List<String> ids=new ArrayList<>();targets.forEach(f->ids.add(f.key));Collections.sort(ids);
    String key=ids+"/"+a.root.key()+"/"+b.root.key()+"/"+a.hub+"/"+b.hub;
    List<Component> cached=groupCache.get(key);if(cached!=null)return cached;
    List<Component> result=new ArrayList<>();
    if(targets.size()==1) {
      Feature target=targets.get(0);
      for(Component source:List.of(a,b)) for(Branch branch:source.branches)
        if(branch.target.key.equals(target.key)) {
          Component direct=resized(source.root,null,null,List.of(new Branch(target,combined(source,branch),50)));
          if(direct!=null && optimizer.valid(direct)) result.add(direct);
        }
    } else {
      Map<String,Coordinate> hubs=new TreeMap<>();
      if(a.hub!=null)hubs.put(Metric.key(a.hub),a.hub);
      if(b.hub!=null)hubs.put(Metric.key(b.hub),b.hub);
      Coordinate center=new Coordinate();
      for(Feature f:targets){center.x+=f.geometry().getCoordinate().x;center.y+=f.geometry().getCoordinate().y;}
      center.x/=targets.size();center.y/=targets.size();
      for(Component source:List.of(a,b)) {
        LineString path=source.trunk==null?source.branches.get(0).line:source.trunk;
        LengthIndexedLine index=new LengthIndexedLine(path);
        for(double t:new double[]{index.project(center),path.getLength()*.4,path.getLength()*.7})
          if(t>1e-4 && t<path.getLength()-1e-4) {
            Coordinate p=index.extractPoint(t);hubs.put(Metric.key(p),p);
          }
      }
      for(Root root:List.of(a.root,b.root)) for(Coordinate hub:hubs.values()) {
        Component c=optimizer.shared(root,hub,targets);
        if(c!=null)result.add(c);
      }
    }
    result.sort(Comparator.comparing(this::score).thenComparing(c->c.root.key()));
    if(result.size()>5) result=new ArrayList<>(result.subList(0,5));
    groupCache.put(key,result);return result;
  }

  private void repartition(Variant network) {
    // Exchange targets between nearby components; also test 2+2 -> 1+3 regrouping.
    for(int round=0;round<2;round++) {
      Component oldA=null,oldB=null,newA=null,newB=null;BigDecimal gain=MIN_GAIN;
      for(int i=0;i<network.components.size();i++) for(int j=i+1;j<network.components.size();j++) {
        Component a=network.components.get(i),b=network.components.get(j);
        int count=a.branches.size()+b.branches.size(); if(count<3||count>4)continue;
        double separation=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
        for(Branch x:a.branches)for(Branch y:b.branches)
          separation=Math.min(separation,x.target.geometry().distance(y.target.geometry()));
        if(separation>200)continue;
        List<Feature> targets=new ArrayList<>();a.branches.forEach(x->targets.add(x.target));b.branches.forEach(x->targets.add(x.target));
        targets.sort(Comparator.comparing(f->f.key));
        List<Component> rest=new ArrayList<>(network.components);rest.remove(a);rest.remove(b);
        BigDecimal old=score(a).add(score(b));
        for(int mask=1;mask<(1<<count)-1;mask++) {
          if((mask&1)==0)continue; // Each unordered partition once.
          List<Feature> left=new ArrayList<>(),right=new ArrayList<>();
          for(int k=0;k<count;k++) ((mask&(1<<k))!=0?left:right).add(targets.get(k));
          if(left.size()>3||right.size()>3)continue;
          for(Component ca:alternatives(left,a,b)) {
            if(!optimizer.compatible(ca,rest))continue;
            List<Component> others=new ArrayList<>(rest);others.add(ca);
            for(Component cb:alternatives(right,a,b)) {
              checks++;
              BigDecimal saving=old.subtract(score(ca)).subtract(score(cb));
              if(saving.compareTo(gain)<=0||!optimizer.compatible(cb,others))continue;
              gain=saving;oldA=a;oldB=b;newA=ca;newB=cb;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if(newA==null)break;
      network.components.remove(oldA);network.components.remove(oldB);
      network.components.add(newA);network.components.add(newB);accepted++;
      optimizer.score(network);
    }
  }
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.constraints.EntryPolicy;
import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine.Span;
import com.heatroute.cost.CostFunction;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.*;
import com.heatroute.routing.VisibilityRouter;
import com.heatroute.tiein.TieInPlanner;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;

public final class Optimizer {
  private final Snapshot s;
  private final ConstraintEngine rules;
  private final VisibilityRouter router;
  private final TieInPlanner tie;
  private final TreeHydraulics hydraulic = new TreeHydraulics();
  private final Map<String, List<Component>> independent = new TreeMap<>();
  private final Consumer<Map<String, Object>> progress;
  private int evaluated, merges;

  public Optimizer(Snapshot s, Consumer<Map<String, Object>> progress) {
    this.s = s;
    rules = new ConstraintEngine(s);
    router = new VisibilityRouter(s, rules);
    tie = new TieInPlanner(s);
    this.progress = progress;
  }

  public static final class Result {
    public final List<Variant> variants;
    public final Map<String, Object> report;

    Result(List<Variant> v, Map<String, Object> r) {
      variants = v;
      report = r;
    }
  }

  public Result solve() {
    long start = System.nanoTime();
    var terminalPlans = router.prepareTerminalEntries();
    progress.accept(Map.of("phase","TERMINAL_ENTRIES_READY","targets",terminalPlans.size()));
    int done = 0;
    for (Feature target : s.targets) {
      independent.put(target.key, individual(target));
      progress.accept(
          Map.of(
              "phase",
              "ROUTING",
              "targetsDone",
              ++done,
              "targetsTotal",
              s.targets.size(),
              "edgeChecks",
              router.edgeChecks,
              "targetId",
              target.id,
              "candidates",
              independent.get(target.key).size()));
    }
    List<Variant> portfolio = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Variant> baselines = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int strategy = 0; strategy < 4; strategy++) {
      Variant v = assemble(strategy);
      repair(v);
      portfolio.add(v);
      baselines.add(v);
      if (strategy < 2) {
        Variant shared = copy(v);
        merge(shared);
        score(shared);
        portfolio.add(shared);
      }
      progress.accept(
          Map.of(
              "phase",
              "OPTIMIZING",
              "variantsEvaluated",
              portfolio.size(),
              "edgeChecks",
              router.edgeChecks));
    }
    for (Variant extra : beamAssemble()) {
      repair(extra);
      portfolio.add(extra);
    }
    // Never trade a reachable goal for a lower monetary score. Keep maximal coverage first.
    int missing = portfolio.stream().mapToInt(v -> v.missing.size()).min().orElse(s.targets.size());
    portfolio.removeIf(v -> v.missing.size() != missing);
    Comparator<Variant> order = Comparator.comparing((Variant v) -> v.score)
        .thenComparing(v -> v.total()).thenComparing(v -> v.length).thenComparing(v -> v.fingerprint);
    portfolio.sort(order);
    List<Variant> seeds = new ArrayList<>(portfolio.subList(0, Math.min(3, portfolio.size())));
    NetworkRefiner refiner = new NetworkRefiner(s, this, progress);
    List<Map<String,Object>> refinementReports = new ArrayList<>();
    int seedNumber = 0;
    for (Variant seed : seeds) {
      Variant polished = copy(seed);
      score(polished);
      refinementReports.add(refiner.refine(polished, ++seedNumber));
      portfolio.add(polished);
    }
    portfolio.sort(
        Comparator.comparing((Variant v) -> v.score)
            .thenComparing(v -> v.total())
            .thenComparing(v -> v.length)
            .thenComparing(v -> v.fingerprint));
    List<Variant> selected = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Variant v : portfolio) {
      boolean duplicate = false;
      for (Variant a : selected) if (similar(v, a)) duplicate = true;
      if (!duplicate) selected.add(v);
      if (selected.size() == 3) break;
    }
    for (Variant v : selected) new SolutionVerifier(s).verify(v);
    List<Map<String, Object>> explanations = new ArrayList<>();
    int rank = 0;
    for (Variant v : selected) {
      Map<String, Object> e = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      e.put("variantId", "v" + (++rank));
      e.put("fingerprint", v.fingerprint);
      e.put("pipeCost", v.pipeCost);
      e.put("chamberCost", v.chamberCost);
      e.put("tieInCost", v.tieCost);
      e.put("penalty", v.penalty);
      e.put("constructionCost", v.construction());
      e.put(
          "scoreCostContribution",
          v.total().multiply(new BigDecimal("0.7")).divide(new BigDecimal("25000000")));
      e.put(
          "scoreLengthContribution",
          v.length.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.3")).divide(new BigDecimal("100")));
      e.put("sharedComponents", v.components.stream().filter(c -> c.trunk != null).count());
      Variant baseline =
          baselines.stream()
              .filter(b -> sameCoverage(b, v))
              .min(Comparator.comparing(b -> b.score))
              .orElse(null);
      if (baseline != null) {
        e.put("comparisonBaselineScore", baseline.score);
        e.put("scoreImprovement", baseline.score.subtract(v.score));
        e.put("constructionSaving", baseline.construction().subtract(v.construction()));
        e.put(
            "comparisonMeaning",
            "Best found pre-merge network with the same connected targets; not global optimum");
      }
      e.put("targetDiagnostics", TargetDiagnostics.describe(s, v));
      explanations.add(e);
    }
    Map<String, Object> report = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    report.put("algorithm", EntryPolicy.nearestOnly()
        ? "OPTIMUS reverse terminal intervals / 2.1"
        : "OPTIMUS admissible entries, joint routing and monotone network refinement / 2.2");
    report.put("terminalEntryPlans",terminalPlans);
    report.put("networkRefinement", refinementReports);
    report.put("entryPolicy", EntryPolicy.name());
    report.put("entryPolicyBasis", EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() ? "Organizer clarification 3: nearest boundary" : "User-selected interpretation: feasible facade entry selected by construction cost");
    report.put(
        "specification", EntryPolicy.nearestOnly()
            ? "LCT updated specification and clarifications"
            : "LCT updated calculation rules with user-selected admissible facade entry; "
                + "global nearest-boundary requirement is not enforced");
    report.put("nearestBoundaryRequired", EntryPolicy.nearestOnly());
    report.put("targetDiagnostics", TargetDiagnostics.describe(s, selected.get(0)));
    report.put("variantExplanations", explanations);
    report.put("features", s.features.size());
    report.put("targets", s.targets.size());
    report.put("connected", s.targets.size() - missing);
    report.put("candidateEvaluations", evaluated);
    report.put("acceptedMerges", merges);
    report.put("cacheHits", router.cacheHits);
    report.put("edgeChecks", router.edgeChecks);
    report.put("rejectedChecks", router.rejected);
    report.put("elapsedMillis", (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1000000);
    report.put("globalOptimalityProven", false);
    report.put(
        "unconnectedMeans",
        "No feasible route found within documented search budget; not a proof of infeasibility");
    report.put("depthMode", false);
    report.put("coordinateSrid", 32637);
    report.put("warnings", s.warnings);
    report.put(
        "fingerprints",
        selected.stream().map(v -> v.fingerprint).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList()));
    return new Result(selected, report);
  }

  private boolean sameCoverage(Variant a, Variant b) {
    Set<String> aa = new TreeSet<>(), bb = new TreeSet<>();
    a.missing.forEach(f -> aa.add(f.key));
    b.missing.forEach(f -> bb.add(f.key));
    return aa.equals(bb);
  }

  private List<Component> individual(Feature f) {
    List<Component> all = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Root> roots = tie.candidates(f.geometry().getCoordinate());
    int attempts = 0;
    for (Root root : roots) {
      LineString route =
          fastSized(root.point, f.geometry().getCoordinate(), f.flow, root.incident, f);
      if (route != null) {
        Component c = hydraulic.size(root, null, null, List.of(new Branch(f, route, 50)));
        if (valid(c)) {
          all.add(c);
          evaluated++;
        }
      }
    }
    if (all.size() < 6)
      for (Root root : roots) {
        if (attempts++ >= 16 && !all.isEmpty()) break;
        if (attempts > 30) break;
        LineString route =
            sizedRoute(root.point, f.geometry().getCoordinate(), f.flow, root.incident, f);
        if (route != null) {
          Component c = hydraulic.size(root, null, null, List.of(new Branch(f, route, 50)));
          if (valid(c)) {
            all.add(c);
            evaluated++;
          }
        }
        if (all.size() >= 6) break;
      }
    all.sort(Comparator.comparing(this::componentCost).thenComparing(c -> c.root.key()));
    return all;
  }

  private LineString fastSized(
      Coordinate from, Coordinate to, BigDecimal flow, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    int trials = 0;
    for (var row : DiameterCatalog.ALL) {
      if (row.capacity.compareTo(flow) < 0 || row.maxLength < from.distance(to)) continue;
      if (trials++ >= 4) break;
      LineString r = router.fast(from, to, row.dn, incident, target);
      if (r != null) return r;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private LineString sizedRoute(
      Coordinate from, Coordinate to, BigDecimal flow, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    int trials = 0;
    for (var row : DiameterCatalog.ALL) {
      if (row.capacity.compareTo(flow) < 0 || row.maxLength < from.distance(to)) continue;
      if (trials++ >= 4) break;
      LineString route = router.route(from, to, row.dn, incident, target);
      if (route != null) return route;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private Variant assemble(int strategy) {
    Variant v = new Variant();
    List<Feature> order = new ArrayList<>(s.targets);
    if (strategy == 1)
      order.sort(Comparator.comparing(Feature -> Feature.flow, Comparator.reverseOrder()));
    if (strategy == 2) Collections.reverse(order);
    if (strategy == 3)
      order.sort(
          Comparator.comparingInt((Feature f) -> independent.get(f.key).size())
              .thenComparing(f -> f.key));
    for (Feature f : order) {
      List<Component> candidates = new ArrayList<>(independent.get(f.key));
      if (strategy == 2 && candidates.size() > 1) Collections.rotate(candidates, -1);
      Component chosen = null;
      for (Component c : candidates)
        if (compatible(c, v.components)) {
          chosen = c;
          break;
        }
      if (chosen != null) v.components.add(chosen);
      else v.missing.add(f);
    }
    // Repair isolated ordering conflicts using alternatives for a conflicting component.
    for (Feature f : new ArrayList<>(v.missing))
      for (Component candidate : independent.get(f.key)) {
        List<Component> conflicts = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Component c : v.components) if (!compatible(candidate, List.of(c))) conflicts.add(c);
        if (conflicts.size() != 1) continue;
        Component old = conflicts.get(0);
        if (old.branches.size() != 1) continue;
        List<Component> remaining = new ArrayList<>(v.components);
        remaining.remove(old);
        if (!compatible(candidate, remaining)) continue;
        remaining.add(candidate);
        Component replacement = null;
        for (Component c : independent.get(old.branches.get(0).target.key))
          if (compatible(c, remaining)) {
            replacement = c;
            break;
          }
        if (replacement != null) {
          remaining.add(replacement);
          v.components.clear();
          v.components.addAll(remaining);
          v.missing.remove(f);
          break;
        }
      }
    score(v);
    return v;
  }

  // Keep several mutually compatible partial networks instead of one greedy choice.
  private List<Variant> beamAssemble() {
    List<Feature> order = new ArrayList<>(s.targets);
    order.sort(Comparator.comparingInt((Feature f)->independent.get(f.key).size()).thenComparing(f->f.key));
    List<Variant> beam = new ArrayList<>(); beam.add(new Variant());
    for (Feature f : order) {
      List<Variant> next = new ArrayList<>();
      for (Variant partial : beam) {
        int retained=0;
        for (Component candidate : independent.get(f.key)) {
          if (!compatible(candidate,partial.components)) continue;
          Variant v=copy(partial); v.components.add(candidate); score(v); next.add(v);
          if (++retained>=12) break;
        }
        Variant skipped=copy(partial); skipped.missing.add(f); score(skipped); next.add(skipped);
      }
      next.sort(Comparator.comparingInt((Variant v)->v.missing.size()).thenComparing(v->v.score).thenComparing(v->v.fingerprint));
      Map<String,Variant> unique=new LinkedHashMap<>();
      for(Variant v:next) { unique.putIfAbsent(v.fingerprint+v.missing.toString(),v); if(unique.size()>=48)break; }
      beam=new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
    }
    return beam.subList(0,Math.min(2,beam.size()));
  }

  private void repair(Variant v) {
    for (Feature f : new ArrayList<>(v.missing)) {
      if (independent.get(f.key).isEmpty()) continue;
      Component joined = null, replaced = null;
      List<Component> nearby = new ArrayList<>(v.components);
      nearby.sort(
          Comparator.comparingDouble(
              c -> c.branches.get(0).target.geometry().distance(f.geometry())));
      for (Component base : nearby) {
        if (base.branches.size() != 1
            || base.branches.get(0).target.geometry().distance(f.geometry()) > 200) continue;
        for (Component candidate : sharedOnPath(base, f, true)) {
          List<Component> rest = new ArrayList<>(v.components);
          rest.remove(base);
          if (compatible(candidate, rest)
              && (joined == null
                  || componentScore(candidate).compareTo(componentScore(joined)) < 0)) {
            joined = candidate;
            replaced = base;
          }
        }
        if (joined != null) break;
      }
      if (joined != null) {
        v.components.remove(replaced);
        v.components.add(joined);
        v.missing.remove(f);
        merges++;
        continue;
      }
      List<Feature> obstacles = new ArrayList<>(s.features);
      int id = 0;
      for (Component c : v.components)
        for (LineString l : lines(c))
          obstacles.add(
              new Feature(
                  com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.TextNode.valueOf("__reserved_" + (++id)),
                  "restriction",
                  "reserved_route",
                  l,
                  0,
                  BigDecimal.ZERO));
      Snapshot local = new Snapshot(obstacles);
      VisibilityRouter alternate = new VisibilityRouter(local, new ConstraintEngine(local));
      int tried = 0;
      for (Root root : tie.candidates(f.geometry().getCoordinate())) {
        if (tried++ >= 32) break;
        Component candidate = null;
        int dns = 0;
        for (var row : DiameterCatalog.ALL) {
          if (row.capacity.compareTo(f.flow) < 0
              || row.maxLength < root.point.distance(f.geometry().getCoordinate())) continue;
          if (dns++ >= 3) break;
          LineString path =
              alternate.route(root.point, f.geometry().getCoordinate(), row.dn, root.incident, f);
          if (path == null) continue;
          Component c = hydraulic.size(root, null, null, List.of(new Branch(f, path, 50)));
          if (valid(c) && compatible(c, v.components)) {
            candidate = c;
            break;
          }
        }
        if (candidate != null) {
          v.components.add(candidate);
          v.missing.remove(f);
          evaluated++;
          break;
        }
      }
      progress.accept(
          Map.of(
              "phase",
              "REPAIRING",
              "targetId",
              f.id,
              "connected",
              s.targets.size() - v.missing.size(),
              "targetsTotal",
              s.targets.size()));
    }
    score(v);
  }

  void merge(Variant variant) {
    boolean improved = true;
    int rounds = 0;
    while (improved && rounds++ < s.targets.size()) {
      improved = false;
      Component best = null;
      Component ba = null, bb = null;
      BigDecimal saving = BigDecimal.ZERO;
      for (int i = 0; i < variant.components.size(); i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j < variant.components.size(); j++) {
          Component a = variant.components.get(i), b = variant.components.get(j);
          if (a.branches.size() + b.branches.size() > 3) continue;
          List<Feature> targets = new ArrayList<>();
          a.branches.forEach(x -> targets.add(x.target));
          b.branches.forEach(x -> targets.add(x.target));
          Coordinate centroid = new Coordinate();
          for (Feature f : targets) {
            centroid.x += f.geometry().getCoordinate().x;
            centroid.y += f.geometry().getCoordinate().y;
          }
          centroid.x /= targets.size();
          centroid.y /= targets.size();
          double spread = 0;
          for (Feature f : targets)
            spread = Math.max(spread, centroid.distance(f.geometry().getCoordinate()));
          if (spread > 150) continue;
          List<Component> others = new ArrayList<>(variant.components);
          others.remove(a);
          others.remove(b);
          if (a.branches.size() == 1 && b.branches.size() == 1)
            for (Component proposed : sharedOnPath(a, b.branches.get(0).target, false))
              if (compatible(proposed, others)) {
                BigDecimal delta =
                    componentScore(a).add(componentScore(b)).subtract(componentScore(proposed));
                if (delta.compareTo(saving) > 0) {
                  saving = delta;
                  best = proposed;
                  ba = a;
                  bb = b;
                }
              }
          for (Root root : List.of(a.root, b.root))
            for (double fraction : new double[] {.45, .70}) {
              Coordinate hub =
                  new Coordinate(
                      root.point.x + (centroid.x - root.point.x) * fraction,
                      root.point.y + (centroid.y - root.point.y) * fraction);
              Component proposed = shared(root, hub, targets);
              if (proposed == null || !compatible(proposed, others)) continue;
              BigDecimal delta =
                  componentScore(a).add(componentScore(b)).subtract(componentScore(proposed));
              if (delta.compareTo(saving) > 0) {
                saving = delta;
                best = proposed;
                ba = a;
                bb = b;
              }
            }
        }
      if (best != null) {
        variant.components.remove(ba);
        variant.components.remove(bb);
        variant.components.add(best);
        improved = true;
        merges++;
      }
    }
  }

  private List<Component> sharedOnPath(Component base, Feature additional, boolean deep) {
    List<Component> found = new ArrayList<>();
    if (base.branches.size() != 1 || base.trunk != null) return found;
    Branch old = base.branches.get(0);
    LineString original = old.line;
    TreeSet<Double> positions = new TreeSet<>();
    positions.add(original.getLength() * .4);
    positions.add(original.getLength() * .7);
    double length = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < original.getNumPoints() - 1; i++) {
      length += original.getCoordinateN(i).distance(original.getCoordinateN(i - 1));
      positions.add(length);
    }
    var index = new org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine(original);
    double nearest = index.project(additional.geometry().getCoordinate());
    for(double shift:new double[]{-32,-16,-8,-4,-2,0,2,4,8,16,32})
      if(nearest+shift>1e-4 && nearest+shift<original.getLength()-1e-4) positions.add(nearest+shift);
    for(int i=1;i<16;i++) positions.add(original.getLength()*i/16.0);
    List<Double> choices = new ArrayList<>(positions);
    choices.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble((Double at)->index.extractPoint(at).distance(additional.geometry().getCoordinate())).thenComparingDouble(at->at));
    int attempted = 0;
    for (double at : choices) {
      if (at < 1e-4 || original.getLength() - at < 1e-4) continue;
      if (attempted++ >= (deep ? 24 : 10)) break;
      LineString trunk = Metric.part(original, 0, at),
          leaf = Metric.part(original, at, original.getLength());
      Coordinate hub = trunk.getEndPoint().getCoordinate();
      LineString other =
          fastSized(
              hub, additional.geometry().getCoordinate(), additional.flow, Set.of(), additional);
      if (other == null && deep && attempted <= 12)
        other =
            sizedRoute(
                hub, additional.geometry().getCoordinate(), additional.flow, Set.of(), additional);
      if (other == null) continue;
      try {
        Component c =
            hydraulic.size(
                base.root,
                hub,
                trunk,
                List.of(new Branch(old.target, leaf, old.dn), new Branch(additional, other, 50)));
        evaluated++;
        if (valid(c)) found.add(c);
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
      }
    }
    return found;
  }

  Component shared(Root root, Coordinate hub, List<Feature> targets) {
    BigDecimal total = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    for (Feature f : targets) total = total.add(f.flow);
    LineString trunk = fastSized(root.point, hub, total, root.incident, null);
    if (trunk == null) return null;
    List<Branch> branches = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Feature f : targets) {
      LineString line = fastSized(hub, f.geometry().getCoordinate(), f.flow, Set.of(), f);
      if (line == null) return null;
      branches.add(new Branch(f, line, 50));
    }
    try {
      Component result = hydraulic.size(root, hub, trunk, branches);
      evaluated++;
      return valid(result) ? result : null;
    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  boolean valid(Component c) {
    if (c.root.degree + 1 > 4) return false;
    if (c.trunk != null && !rules.assess(c.trunk, c.trunkDn, c.root.incident, null).valid())
      return false;
    for (Branch b : c.branches)
      if (!rules
          .assess(b.line, b.dn, c.trunk == null ? c.root.incident : Set.of(), b.target)
          .valid()) return false;
    if (c.trunk != null)
      for (Branch b : c.branches)
        if (!Metric.turn(
            c.trunk.getCoordinateN(c.trunk.getNumPoints() - 2), c.hub, b.line.getCoordinateN(1)))
          return false;
    List<LineString> lines = lines(c);
    for (int i = 0; i < lines.size(); i++)
      for (int j = i + 1; j < lines.size(); j++)
        if (!onlySharedEndpoint(lines.get(i), lines.get(j))) return false;
    return true;
  }

  static boolean onlySharedEndpoint(LineString a, LineString b) {
    Geometry cross = a.intersection(b);
    if (cross.isEmpty()) return true;
    if (cross.getDimension() > 0) return false;
    for (Coordinate c : cross.getCoordinates())
      if (Math.min(
                  c.distance(a.getCoordinateN(0)),
                  c.distance(a.getCoordinateN(a.getNumPoints() - 1)))
              > 1e-6
          || Math.min(
                  c.distance(b.getCoordinateN(0)),
                  c.distance(b.getCoordinateN(b.getNumPoints() - 1)))
              > 1e-6) return false;
    return true;
  }

  boolean compatible(Component candidate, List<Component> existing) {
    int added = 1;
    for (Component c : existing) {
      if (candidate.root.point.distance(c.root.point) < 1e-5) {
        if (candidate.root.existingChamber == null || c.root.existingChamber == null) return false;
        added++;
      }
      for (LineString a : lines(candidate))
        for (LineString b : lines(c)) {
          Geometry x = a.intersection(b);
          if (x.isEmpty()) continue;
          if (x.getDimension() > 0) return false;
          for (Coordinate p : x.getCoordinates())
            if (candidate.root.existingChamber == null
                || c.root.existingChamber == null
                || !candidate.root.existingChamber.key.equals(c.root.existingChamber.key)
                || p.distance(candidate.root.point) > 1e-6) return false;
        }
    }
    return candidate.root.degree + added <= 4;
  }

  static List<LineString> lines(Component c) {
    List<LineString> lines = new ArrayList<>();
    if (c.trunk != null) lines.add(c.trunk);
    c.branches.forEach(b -> lines.add(b.line));
    return lines;
  }

  private Variant copy(Variant source) {
    Variant v = new Variant();
    v.components.addAll(source.components);
    v.missing.addAll(source.missing);
    return v;
  }

  private BigDecimal componentCost(Component c) {
    Variant v = new Variant();
    v.components.add(c);
    score(v);
    return v.construction();
  }

  BigDecimal componentScore(Component c) {
    Variant v = new Variant();
    v.components.add(c);
    score(v);
    return v.score;
  }

  public void score(Variant v) {
    v.pipeCost = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    v.chamberCost = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    v.tieCost = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    v.penalty = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    v.length = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    v.tieCount = 0;
    List<String> topology = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Component c : v.components) {
      int max = c.root.existingDn;
      if (c.trunk != null) {
        addLine(v, c.trunk, c.trunkDn, c.root.incident, null);
        max = Math.max(max, c.trunkDn);
        int hubDn = c.trunkDn;
        for (Branch b : c.branches) hubDn = Math.max(hubDn, b.dn);
        v.chamberCost = v.chamberCost.add(CostFunction.chamber(hubDn));
      }
      for (Branch b : c.branches) {
        addLine(v, b.line, b.dn, c.trunk == null ? c.root.incident : Set.of(), b.target);
        if (c.trunk == null) max = Math.max(max, b.dn);
        topology.add(b.target.key + "/" + c.root.key() + "/" + b.dn + "/" + b.line.toText());
      }
      if (c.root.existingChamber == null)
        v.chamberCost = v.chamberCost.add(CostFunction.chamber(max));
      else {
        v.tieCount++;
        v.tieCost = v.tieCost.add(CostFunction.tie());
      }
      if (c.trunk != null) topology.add("trunk/" + c.trunkDn + "/" + c.trunk.toText());
    }
    v.missing.sort(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.key));
    for (Feature f : v.missing) {
      v.penalty = v.penalty.add(CostFunction.penalty(f.flow));
      topology.add("missing/" + f.key);
    }
    v.score = CostFunction.score(v.total(), v.length);
    Collections.sort(topology);
    v.fingerprint = sha(String.join("\n", topology));
  }

  private void addLine(Variant v, LineString line, int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    var check = rules.assess(line, dn, incident, target);
    if (!check.valid()) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid costed route: " + check.error);
    v.length = v.length.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(line.getLength()));
    for (Span part : rules.partition(line, check.spans))
      v.pipeCost = v.pipeCost.add(CostFunction.pipe(part.b - part.a, dn, part.factor));
  }

  private boolean similar(Variant a, Variant b) {
    if (a.components.size() != b.components.size() || a.missing.size() != b.missing.size())
      return false;
    Set<String> ga = new TreeSet<>(), gb = new TreeSet<>();
    for (Component c : a.components) ga.add(group(c));
    for (Component c : b.components) gb.add(group(c));
    if (!ga.equals(gb)) return false;
    List<LineString> la = new ArrayList<>(), lb = new ArrayList<>();
    a.components.forEach(c -> la.addAll(lines(c)));
    b.components.forEach(c -> lb.addAll(lines(c)));
    if (la.isEmpty() || lb.isEmpty()) return la.isEmpty() && lb.isEmpty();
    Geometry x = Metric.GF.createMultiLineString(la.toArray(new LineString[0])),
        y = Metric.GF.createMultiLineString(lb.toArray(new LineString[0]));
    return x.buffer(5).covers(y) && y.buffer(5).covers(x);
  }

  String group(Component c) {
    List<String> ids = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Branch b : c.branches) ids.add(b.target.key + ":" + b.dn);
    Collections.sort(ids);
    return ids
        + "/"
        + c.trunkDn
        + "/"
        + (c.root.existingChamber == null ? "new" : c.root.existingChamber.key);
  }

  private String sha(String value) {
    try {
      byte[] bytes =
          MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
      StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
      for (byte x : bytes) b.append(String.format("%02x", x));
      return b.toString();
    } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.TreeHydraulics;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;

/** A separate final gate, independent of search ordering and cached acceptance decisions. */
public final class SolutionVerifier {
  private final Snapshot s;

  public SolutionVerifier(Snapshot s) {
    this.s = s;
  }

  public void verify(Variant v) {
    Set<String> assigned = new HashSet<>();
    ConstraintEngine rules = new ConstraintEngine(s);
    Map<String, Integer> tieCounts = new HashMap<>();
    List<LineString> all = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Component c : v.components) {
      Component expected = new TreeHydraulics().size(c.root, c.hub, c.trunk, c.branches);
      require(expected.trunkDn == c.trunkDn, "Trunk diameter not minimal");
      if (c.root.existingChamber != null) {
        int n = tieCounts.merge(c.root.existingChamber.key, 1, Integer::sum);
        require(c.root.degree + n <= 4, "Existing chamber degree");
      } else require(c.root.degree + 1 <= 4, "New root degree");
      if (c.trunk != null) {
        require(c.branches.size() + 1 <= 4, "Branch degree");
        require(
            c.trunk.getStartPoint().distance(Metric.point(c.root.point)) < 1e-6
                && c.trunk.getEndPoint().distance(Metric.point(c.hub)) < 1e-6,
            "Trunk endpoints");
        require(
            rules.assess(c.trunk, c.trunkDn, c.root.incident, null).valid(), "Trunk constraints");
        all.add(c.trunk);
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < c.branches.size(); i++) {
        Branch b = c.branches.get(i);
        if (c.trunk != null)
          require(
              Metric.turn(
                  c.trunk.getCoordinateN(c.trunk.getNumPoints() - 2),
                  c.hub,
                  b.line.getCoordinateN(1)),
              "Turn through chamber");
        require(assigned.add(b.target.key), "Duplicate target");
        require(b.dn == expected.branches.get(i).dn, "Leaf diameter not minimal");
        require(
            b.line.getStartPoint().distance(Metric.point(c.trunk == null ? c.root.point : c.hub))
                    < 1e-6
                && b.line.getEndPoint().distance(b.target.geometry()) < 1e-6,
            "Leaf endpoints");
        require(
            rules
                .assess(b.line, b.dn, c.trunk == null ? c.root.incident : Set.of(), b.target)
                .valid(),
            "Leaf constraints");
        all.add(b.line);
      }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); i++)
      for (int j = i + 1; j < all.size(); j++)
        require(Optimizer.onlySharedEndpoint(all.get(i), all.get(j)), "Unnoded intersection");
    for (Feature f : v.missing) require(assigned.add(f.key), "Duplicate missing");
    require(assigned.size() == s.targets.size(), "Targets lost");
    for (Feature f : s.targets) require(assigned.contains(f.key), "Target not accounted");
  }

  private void require(boolean ok, String detail) {
    if (!ok) throw new IllegalStateException("Verification failed: " + detail);
  }
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.constraints.EntryPolicy;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.distance.DistanceOp;

/** Explanations are observations, not unjustified infeasibility certificates. */
public final class TargetDiagnostics {
  public static List<Map<String, Object>> describe(Snapshot s, Variant selected) {
    Set<String> missing = new HashSet<>();
    selected.missing.forEach(f -> missing.add(f.key));
    List<Map<String, Object>> out = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Feature target : s.targets) {
      Map<String, Object> d = new LinkedHashMap<>();
      d.put("targetId", target.id);
      d.put("flowTph", target.flow);
      d.put("status", missing.contains(target.key) ? "NO_ROUTE_FOUND" : "CONNECTED");
      d.put("infeasibilityProven", false);
      d.put("entryPolicy", EntryPolicy.name());
      for (Component c : selected.components) for (Branch branch : c.branches)
        if (branch.target.key.equals(target.key)) {
          Coordinate[] coords = branch.line.getCoordinates();
          Geometry leg = Metric.line(coords[coords.length - 2], coords[coords.length - 1]);
          for (Feature own : s.nearby(target.envelope))
            if (own.restriction.equals("oks") && own.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) {
              Geometry crossing = leg.intersection(own.geometry().getBoundary());
              d.put("selectedEntryWgs84", Metric.transform(crossing, false).toText());
              d.put("finalStraightLengthM", leg.getLength());
              d.put("internalEntryLengthM", leg.intersection(own.geometry()).getLength());
            }
        }
      double lower =
          s.nearestNetworks(target.geometry().getCoordinate(), 1).stream()
              .mapToDouble(f -> f.geometry().distance(target.geometry()))
              .min()
              .orElse(0);
      d.put("distanceLowerBoundM", lower);
      try {
        int dn = DiameterCatalog.select(target.flow, 0, 0).dn;
        d.put("diameterLowerBound", dn);
        for (Feature owner : s.nearby(target.geometry().getEnvelopeInternal()))
          if (owner.restriction.equals("oks") && owner.geometry().getDimension()==2 && owner.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) {
            d.put("ownBuildingId", owner.id);
            Coordinate end = target.geometry().getCoordinate(),
                boundary =
                    DistanceOp.nearestPoints(owner.geometry().getBoundary(), target.geometry())[0];
            Point boundaryPoint = Metric.point(boundary);
            Coordinate wgs = Metric.transform(boundaryPoint, false).getCoordinate();
            d.put("nearestBoundaryWgs84", List.of(wgs.x, wgs.y));
            boolean courtyard = false;
            for (int k = 0; k < owner.geometry().getNumGeometries(); k++) {
              Polygon poly = (Polygon) owner.geometry().getGeometryN(k);
              for (int j = 0; j < poly.getNumInteriorRing(); j++)
                if (poly.getInteriorRingN(j).distance(boundaryPoint) < 1e-6) courtyard = true;
            }
            d.put("nearestEntryFromCourtyard", courtyard);
            double len = boundary.distance(end);
            if (len > 1e-8) {
              double
                  clearance = ConstraintEngine.gap("oks", dn) + DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width / 2,
                  extension = clearance + .12;
              var certificate = EntryCertificate.prove(s, owner, target, boundary, clearance);
              if (EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && certificate != null && missing.contains(target.key)) {
                d.put("entryCertificate", certificate);
                d.put("infeasibilityProven", true);
                d.put("reason", "UNIQUE_NEAREST_STRAIGHT_ENTRY_BLOCKED");
              }
              Coordinate a =
                  new Coordinate(
                      boundary.x + (boundary.x - end.x) / len * extension,
                      boundary.y + (boundary.y - end.y) / len * extension);
              int tries = 0;
              while (owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(a)) < clearance + .02 && tries++ < 30) {
                extension += Math.max(.25, clearance / 4);
                a =
                    new Coordinate(
                        boundary.x + (boundary.x - end.x) / len * extension,
                        boundary.y + (boundary.y - end.y) / len * extension);
              }
              var check = new ConstraintEngine(s).assess(Metric.line(a, end), dn, Set.of(), target);
              d.put("nearestBoundaryApproachCheck", check.valid() ? "PASS" : check.error);
              d.put("approachClearanceM", owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(a)));
            }
            break;
          }
      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
        d.put("reason", "NO_CATALOG_DIAMETER_FOR_LOWER_BOUND");
        d.put("infeasibilityProven", true);
      }
      if (missing.contains(target.key) && !d.containsKey("reason"))
        d.put(
            "reason",
            "No compatible route found within search budget; review geometry and search"
                + " diagnostics");
      out.add(d);
    }
    return out;
  }

  private TargetDiagnostics() {}
}
