===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/constraints/ConstraintEngine.java BYTES 9798 SHA256 e973635a25b1fd7763f517e82b10969fc7d2ba66ba83e016cc7349ed6dac7278 =====
package com.heatroute.constraints;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.distance.DistanceOp;

public final class ConstraintEngine {
  public static final class Span {
    public final double a, b, factor;
    public final String key;

    public Span(double a, double b, double k, String key) {
      this.a = a;
      this.b = b;
      factor = k;
      this.key = key;
    }
  }

  public static final class Check {
    public final List<Span> spans = new ArrayList<>();
    public String error;

    public boolean valid() {
      return error == null;
    }

    Check fail(String e) {
      error = e;
      return this;
    }
  }

  public static boolean forbidden(String type) {
    return Set.of(
            "oks", "park", "social_area", "prohibited_site", "water", "railway", "reserved_route")
        .contains(type);
  }

  public static double gap(String t, int dn) {
    return t.equals("reserved_route")
        ? .05
        : t.equals("oks")
            ? (dn < 500 ? 5 : dn <= 800 ? 7 : 9)
            : Set.of("road", "tram_tracks").contains(t)
                ? 1.5
                : Set.of("gas_pipeline", "power_cable").contains(t) ? 2 : 1;
  }

  public static double factor(String t) {
    switch (t) {
      case "road":
        return 1.60;
      case "tram_tracks":
        return 1.75;
      case "gas_pipeline":
        return 1.25;
      case "power_cable":
        return 1.15;
      case "heat_network":
        return 1.05;
      default:
        return 1;
    }
  }

  public static double halfOther(Feature f) {
    return f.type.equals("heat_network")
        ? DiameterCatalog.get(f.diameter).width / 2
        : f.restriction.equals("gas_pipeline") ? .2 : f.restriction.equals("power_cable") ? .1 : 0;
  }

  public final Snapshot snapshot;

  public ConstraintEngine(Snapshot s) {
    snapshot = s;
  }

  public Check assess(LineString line, int dn, Set<String> rootExceptions, Feature target) {
    Check out = new Check();
    if (line.isEmpty() || !line.isSimple() || !Metric.turns(line))
      return out.fail("GEOMETRY_OR_TURN");
    double length = line.getLength(), half = DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width / 2;
    LengthIndexedLine indexed = new LengthIndexedLine(line);
    Envelope box = line.getEnvelopeInternal();
    box.expandBy(13);
    for (Feature f : snapshot.nearby(box)) {
      String type = f.type.equals("heat_network") ? "heat_network" : f.restriction;
      if (!forbidden(type) && factor(type) == 1) continue;
      Geometry obstacle = f.geometry();
      double clearance = gap(type, dn) + half + halfOther(f);
      if (line.distance(obstacle) >= clearance - 1e-6) continue;
      if (forbidden(type)) {
        if (type.equals("oks")
            && target != null
            && obstacle.covers(target.geometry())
            && line.getEndPoint().distance(target.geometry()) < 1e-5) {
          Coordinate terminal = target.geometry().getCoordinate(),
              boundary = DistanceOp.nearestPoints(obstacle.getBoundary(), target.geometry())[0];
          LineString finalLeg = Metric.line(line.getCoordinateN(line.getNumPoints() - 2), terminal);
          if (EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && finalLeg.distance(Metric.point(boundary)) > 1e-5)
            return out.fail("OWN_OKS_NEAREST_BOUNDARY:" + f.key);
          if (obstacle.contains(finalLeg.getStartPoint()))
            return out.fail("OWN_OKS_START_INSIDE:" + f.key);
          Geometry inside = finalLeg.intersection(obstacle);
          if (inside.getNumGeometries() != 1
              || inside.getDimension() != 1
              || inside.distance(target.geometry()) > 1e-6)
            return out.fail("OWN_OKS_REENTRY:" + f.key);
          if (line.getNumPoints() > 2) {
            Coordinate[] prefix = Arrays.copyOf(line.getCoordinates(), line.getNumPoints() - 1);
            if (Metric.line(prefix).distance(obstacle) < clearance - 1e-6)
              return out.fail("OWN_OKS_PREFIX:" + f.key);
          }
          continue;
        }
        return out.fail("CLEARANCE:" + f.key);
      }
      Geometry cross = line.intersection(obstacle);
      List<Span> spans = new ArrayList<>();
      if (rootExceptions.contains(f.key) && line.getStartPoint().distance(obstacle) < .15) {
        if (cross.getDimension() > 0 && !cross.isEmpty())
          return out.fail("ROOT_COLLINEAR:" + f.key);
        boolean other = false;
        for (Coordinate c : cross.getCoordinates())
          if (c.distance(line.getCoordinateN(0)) > .15) other = true;
        if (!other) {
          Geometry near = line.intersection(obstacle.buffer(clearance));
          boolean prefixOnly = true;
          for (int k = 0; k < near.getNumGeometries(); k++)
            if (near.getGeometryN(k).distance(line.getStartPoint()) > .15) prefixOnly = false;
          if (prefixOnly) continue;
        }
      }
      if (cross.isEmpty()) return out.fail("NEAR_WITHOUT_CROSSING:" + f.key);
      if (obstacle.getDimension() == 2) {
        for (int i = 0; i < cross.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
          Geometry part = cross.getGeometryN(i);
          if (!(part instanceof LineString) || part.getLength() < 1e-7)
            return out.fail("TANGENCY:" + f.key);
          Coordinate[] cc = part.getCoordinates();
          double a = indexed.project(cc[0]), b = indexed.project(cc[cc.length - 1]);
          if (a > b) {
            double x = a;
            a = b;
            b = x;
          }
          double extend = Set.of("road", "tram_tracks").contains(type) ? 3 : 2;
          if (a - extend < -1e-6 || b + extend > length + 1e-6)
            return out.fail("SPECIAL_EXTENSION:" + f.key);
          LineString special = Metric.part(line, a - extend, b + extend);
          if (!Metric.straight(special)) return out.fail("SPECIAL_NOT_STRAIGHT:" + f.key);
          if (Set.of("road", "tram_tracks").contains(type)
              && angle(special, obstacle.getBoundary(), indexed.extractPoint(a)) < 45 - 1e-7)
            return out.fail("ANGLE:" + f.key);
          spans.add(
              new Span(
                  Math.max(0, a - extend),
                  Math.min(length, b + extend),
                  factor(type),
                  f.key + "/" + i));
        }
      } else {
        if (cross.getDimension() > 0) return out.fail("COLLINEAR:" + f.key);
        for (int i = 0; i < cross.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
          Coordinate c = cross.getGeometryN(i).getCoordinate();
          double p = indexed.project(c),
              extend = Set.of("road", "tram_tracks").contains(type) ? 3 : 2;
          if (p - extend < -1e-6 || p + extend > length + 1e-6)
            return out.fail("SPECIAL_EXTENSION:" + f.key);
          LineString special = Metric.part(line, p - extend, p + extend);
          if (!Metric.straight(special)) return out.fail("SPECIAL_NOT_STRAIGHT:" + f.key);
          if (Set.of("road", "tram_tracks").contains(type)
              && angle(special, obstacle, c) < 45 - 1e-7) return out.fail("ANGLE:" + f.key);
          spans.add(
              new Span(
                  Math.max(0, p - extend),
                  Math.min(length, p + extend),
                  factor(type),
                  f.key + "/" + i));
        }
      }
      // Clearance governs passing alongside an object. A straight transverse crossing
      // must leave the full envelope, even when that envelope exceeds the tariff zone.
      Geometry near = line.intersection(obstacle.buffer(clearance));
      for (int i = 0; i < near.getNumGeometries(); i++) {
        Geometry piece = near.getGeometryN(i);
        if (piece.distance(cross) > 1e-6) return out.fail("NEAR_WITHOUT_CROSSING:" + f.key);
        if (piece instanceof LineString && !Metric.straight((LineString) piece))
          return out.fail("CROSSING_APPROACH_NOT_STRAIGHT:" + f.key);
      }
      out.spans.addAll(spans);
    }
    return out;
  }

  private double angle(LineString route, Geometry boundary, Coordinate at) {
    double result = 90;
    boolean found = false;
    Coordinate a = route.getCoordinateN(0), b = route.getCoordinateN(route.getNumPoints() - 1);
    double vx = b.x - a.x, vy = b.y - a.y;
    for (int k = 0; k < boundary.getNumGeometries(); k++) {
      Coordinate[] cs = boundary.getGeometryN(k).getCoordinates();
      for (int i = 1; i < cs.length; i++) {
        LineSegment segment = new LineSegment(cs[i - 1], cs[i]);
        if (segment.distance(at) > 1e-5) continue;
        double wx = cs[i].x - cs[i - 1].x,
            wy = cs[i].y - cs[i - 1].y,
            den = Math.hypot(vx, vy) * Math.hypot(wx, wy);
        if (den == 0) continue;
        double deg = Math.toDegrees(Math.acos(Math.min(1, Math.abs(vx * wx + vy * wy) / den)));
        result = Math.min(result, deg);
        found = true;
      }
    }
    return found ? result : 0;
  }

  public List<Span> partition(LineString line, List<Span> spans) {
    TreeSet<Double> cuts = new TreeSet<>();
    cuts.add(0.0);
    cuts.add(line.getLength());
    for (Span s : spans) {
      cuts.add(s.a);
      cuts.add(s.b);
    }
    List<Double> v = new ArrayList<>(cuts);
    List<Span> result = new ArrayList<>();
    for (int i = 1; i < v.size(); i++) {
      double a = v.get(i - 1), b = v.get(i);
      if (b - a < 1e-7) continue;
      double middle = (a + b) / 2, k = 1;
      TreeSet<String> active = new TreeSet<>();
      for (Span s : spans)
        if (middle > s.a && middle < s.b) {
          k = Math.max(k, s.factor);
          active.add(s.key);
        }
      result.add(new Span(a, b, k, String.join(",", active)));
    }
    return result;
  }
}

package com.heatroute.constraints;

/** User-selected admissible-entry policy; nearest remains an explicit alternative. */
public final class EntryPolicy {
  public static String name() {
    String value = System.getProperty("heatroute.entryPolicy", "cost");
    if (!value.equals("cost") && !value.equals("nearest"))
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("heatroute.entryPolicy must be cost or nearest");
    return value;
  }
  public static boolean nearestOnly() { return name().equals("nearest"); }
  private EntryPolicy() {}
}

===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/cost/CostFunction.java BYTES 1051 SHA256 55ba546dc325b822bdfdf9a8a118b7ec738049b44c45ada2ec306b225f189d22 =====
package com.heatroute.cost;

import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.math.BigDecimal;

public final class CostFunction {
  public static BigDecimal pipe(double metres, int dn, double factor) {
    return BigDecimal.valueOf(metres)
        .multiply(DiameterCatalog.get(dn).rate)
        .multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(factor));
  }

  public static BigDecimal chamber(int dn) {
    DiameterCatalog.get(dn);
    return BigDecimal.valueOf(
        dn <= 200 ? 3000000 : dn <= 500 ? 5000000 : dn <= 1000 ? 8000000 : 12000000);
  }

  public static BigDecimal tie() {
    return new BigDecimal("5000000");
  }

  public static BigDecimal penalty(BigDecimal flow) {
    return new BigDecimal("100000000").add(flow.multiply(new BigDecimal("500000")));
  }

  public static BigDecimal score(BigDecimal cost, BigDecimal length) {
    return cost.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.7"))
        .divide(new BigDecimal("25000000"))
        .add(length.multiply(new BigDecimal("0.3")).divide(new BigDecimal("100")));
  }

  private CostFunction() {}
}

package com.heatroute.domain;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeometryStore;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.index.strtree.ItemDistance;
import org.locationtech.jts.index.strtree.STRtree;

public final class Model {
  public static String key(JsonNode id) {
    return id.isTextual()
        ? "s:" + id.textValue()
        : "n:" + id.decimalValue().stripTrailingZeros().toPlainString();
  }

  public static final class Feature {
    public final JsonNode id;
    public final String key, type, restriction;
    private final Geometry geometry;
    public final Envelope envelope;
    private final GeometryStore store;
    private final GeometryStore.Ref ref;
    public final int diameter;
    public final BigDecimal flow;

    public Feature(
        JsonNode id,
        String type,
        String restriction,
        Geometry geometry,
        int diameter,
        BigDecimal flow) {
      this.id = id.deepCopy();
      key = key(id);
      this.type = type;
      this.restriction = restriction;
      this.geometry = geometry;
      this.envelope = new Envelope(geometry.getEnvelopeInternal());
      this.store = null;
      this.ref = null;
      this.diameter = diameter;
      this.flow = flow;
    }

    public Geometry geometry() {
      return geometry != null ? geometry : store.get(ref);
    }

    private Feature(Feature f, GeometryStore store, GeometryStore.Ref ref) {
      id = f.id;
      key = f.key;
      type = f.type;
      restriction = f.restriction;
      diameter = f.diameter;
      flow = f.flow;
      envelope = f.envelope;
      geometry = null;
      this.store = store;
      this.ref = ref;
    }

    public Feature spooled(GeometryStore store) throws IOException {
      return new Feature(this, store, store.put(geometry()));
    }
  }

  public static final class Snapshot implements AutoCloseable {
    public final List<Feature> features,
        targets = new ArrayList<>(),
        networks = new ArrayList<>(),
        chambers = new ArrayList<>(),
        obstacles = new ArrayList<>();
    public final Map<String, Feature> byId = new TreeMap<>();
    public final STRtree index = new STRtree(),
        networkIndex = new STRtree(),
        chamberIndex = new STRtree();
    private GeometryStore geometryStore;
    public final List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();

    public Snapshot(List<Feature> source) {
      features = new ArrayList<>(source);
      features.sort(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.key));
      for (Feature f : features) {
        byId.put(f.key, f);
        if (f.type.equals("oks_connection_point")) targets.add(f);
        if (f.type.equals("heat_network")) {
          networks.add(f);
          networkIndex.insert(f.envelope, f);
        }
        if (f.type.equals("heat_chamber")) {
          chambers.add(f);
          chamberIndex.insert(f.envelope, f);
        }
        if (f.type.equals("restriction") || f.type.equals("heat_network")) {
          obstacles.add(f);
          index.insert(f.envelope, f);
        }
      }
      index.build();
      networkIndex.build();
      chamberIndex.build();
    }

    public Snapshot withStore(GeometryStore store) {
      geometryStore = store;
      return this;
    }

    public void close() throws IOException {
      if (geometryStore != null) geometryStore.close();
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public List<Feature> chambersNear(Coordinate p, double radius) {
      Envelope e = new Envelope(p);
      e.expandBy(radius);
      List<Feature> fs = new ArrayList<>(chamberIndex.query(e));
      fs.sort(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.key));
      return fs;
    }

    public List<Feature> nearestNetworks(Coordinate p, int count) {
      if (networks.isEmpty()) return List.of();
      Point query = com.heatroute.geo.Metric.point(p);
      ItemDistance distance =
          (a, b) -> {
            Object x = a.getItem(), y = b.getItem();
            Geometry gx = x instanceof Feature ? ((Feature) x).geometry() : (Geometry) x,
                gy = y instanceof Feature ? ((Feature) y).geometry() : (Geometry) y;
            return gx.distance(gy);
          };
      Object[] objects =
          networkIndex.nearestNeighbour(
              query.getEnvelopeInternal(), query, distance, Math.min(count, networks.size()));
      List<Feature> found = new ArrayList<>();
      for (Object o : objects) found.add((Feature) o);
      found.sort(
          Comparator.comparingDouble((Feature f) -> f.geometry().distance(query))
              .thenComparing(f -> f.key));
      return found;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public List<Feature> nearby(Envelope e) {
      List<Feature> list = new ArrayList<>(index.query(e));
      list.sort(Comparator.comparing(f -> f.key));
      return list;
    }
  }

  public static final class Root {
    public final Coordinate point;
    public final Feature existingChamber;
    public final int existingDn, degree;
    public final Set<String> incident;

    public Root(Coordinate p, Feature ch, int dn, int degree, Set<String> inc) {
      point = p;
      existingChamber = ch;
      existingDn = dn;
      this.degree = degree;
      incident = inc;
    }

    public String key() {
      return (existingChamber == null ? "new" : "old:" + existingChamber.key)
          + ":"
          + point.x
          + ":"
          + point.y;
    }
  }

  public static final class Branch {
    public final Feature target;
    public final LineString line;
    public final int dn;

    public Branch(Feature f, LineString l, int d) {
      target = f;
      line = l;
      dn = d;
    }
  }

  public static final class Component {
    public final Root root;
    public final Coordinate hub;
    public final LineString trunk;
    public final int trunkDn;
    public final List<Branch> branches;

    public Component(Root r, Coordinate h, LineString t, int d, List<Branch> b) {
      root = r;
      hub = h;
      trunk = t;
      trunkDn = d;
      branches = List.copyOf(b);
    }
  }

  public static final class Variant {
    public final List<Component> components = new ArrayList<>();
    public final List<Feature> missing = new ArrayList<>();
    public BigDecimal pipeCost = BigDecimal.ZERO,
        chamberCost = BigDecimal.ZERO,
        tieCost = BigDecimal.ZERO,
        penalty = BigDecimal.ZERO,
        length = BigDecimal.ZERO,
        score = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    public int tieCount;
    public String fingerprint;
    public final Map<String, Object> diagnostics = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public BigDecimal construction() {
      return pipeCost.add(chamberCost).add(tieCost);
    }

    public BigDecimal total() {
      return construction().add(penalty);
    }
  }

  private Model() {}
}

package com.heatroute.export;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonGenerator;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.TextNode;
import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.cost.CostFunction;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.io.geojson.GeoJsonWriter;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;

public final class GeoJsonExporter {
  public void write(Snapshot s, List<Variant> variants, OutputStream output) throws IOException {
    ConstraintEngine rules = new ConstraintEngine(s);
    try (JsonGenerator g = GeoJsonInput.JSON.getFactory().createGenerator(output)) {
      g.writeStartObject();
      g.writeStringField("type", "FeatureCollection");
      g.writeArrayFieldStart("features");
      int rank = 0;
      for (Variant v : variants) {
        String variant = "v" + (++rank);
        Ids ids = new Ids(s, variant);
        for (Component c : v.components) {
          JsonNode root = c.root.existingChamber == null ? ids.next() : c.root.existingChamber.id;
          int rootDn = c.root.existingDn;
          if (c.trunk != null) rootDn = Math.max(rootDn, c.trunkDn);
          else for (Branch b : c.branches) rootDn = Math.max(rootDn, b.dn);
          if (c.root.existingChamber == null) chamber(g, variant, root, c.root.point, rootDn);
          JsonNode origin = root;
          if (c.trunk != null) {
            JsonNode hub = ids.next();
            int hubDn = c.trunkDn;
            BigDecimal q = BigDecimal.ZERO;
            for (Branch b : c.branches) {
              hubDn = Math.max(hubDn, b.dn);
              q = q.add(b.target.flow);
            }
            chamber(g, variant, hub, c.hub, hubDn);
            line(g, variant, ids, c.trunk, c.trunkDn, q, root, hub, rules, c.root.incident, null);
            origin = hub;
          }
          for (Branch b : c.branches)
            line(
                g,
                variant,
                ids,
                b.line,
                b.dn,
                b.target.flow,
                origin,
                b.target.id,
                rules,
                c.trunk == null ? c.root.incident : Set.of(),
                b.target);
        }
        start(g, variant, ids.next(), "variant_summary", null);
        g.writeNumberField("rank", rank);
        g.writeNumberField("construction_cost", v.construction());
        g.writeNumberField("chamber_construction_cost", v.chamberCost);
        g.writeNumberField("existing_chamber_tie_in_count", v.tieCount);
        g.writeNumberField("existing_chamber_tie_in_cost", v.tieCost);
        g.writeNumberField("unconnected_penalty", v.penalty);
        g.writeNumberField("calculated_cost", v.total());
        g.writeNumberField("new_network_length", v.length);
        g.writeNumberField("score", v.score);
        g.writeArrayFieldStart("unconnected_oks_ids");
        for (Feature f : v.missing) g.writeTree(f.id);
        g.writeEndArray();
        g.writeStringField("fingerprint", v.fingerprint);
        end(g);
      }
      g.writeEndArray();
      g.writeEndObject();
    }
  }

  private void line(
      JsonGenerator g,
      String variant,
      Ids ids,
      LineString line,
      int dn,
      BigDecimal flow,
      JsonNode start,
      JsonNode finish,
      ConstraintEngine rules,
      Set<String> incident,
      Feature target)
      throws IOException {
    var check = rules.assess(line, dn, incident, target);
    if (!check.valid()) throw new IOException("Unverified exported line " + check.error);
    var parts = rules.partition(line, check.spans);
    JsonNode from = start;
    LengthIndexedLine indexed = new LengthIndexedLine(line);
    for (int i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
      var p = parts.get(i);
      JsonNode to = i == parts.size() - 1 ? finish : ids.next();
      if (i < parts.size() - 1) {
        start(g, variant, to, "technical_node", Metric.point(indexed.extractPoint(p.b)));
        end(g);
      }
      start(g, variant, ids.next(), "heat_network", Metric.part(line, p.a, p.b));
      g.writeObjectField("start_node_id", from);
      g.writeObjectField("end_node_id", to);
      g.writeNumberField("flow_tph", flow);
      g.writeNumberField("diameter", dn);
      g.writeNumberField("length", p.b - p.a);
      g.writeStringField("laying_method", p.factor > 1 ? "special" : "base");
      g.writeNullField("depth_start");
      g.writeNullField("depth_end");
      g.writeNumberField("cost", CostFunction.pipe(p.b - p.a, dn, p.factor));
      g.writeNumberField("special_factor", p.factor);
      end(g);
      from = to;
    }
  }

  private void chamber(JsonGenerator g, String v, JsonNode id, Coordinate p, int dn)
      throws IOException {
    start(g, v, id, "heat_chamber", Metric.point(p));
    g.writeNumberField("diameter", dn);
    g.writeNumberField("cost", CostFunction.chamber(dn));
    end(g);
  }

  private void start(JsonGenerator g, String variant, JsonNode id, String type, Geometry geometry)
      throws IOException {
    g.writeStartObject();
    g.writeStringField("type", "Feature");
    g.writeFieldName("geometry");
    if (geometry == null) g.writeNull();
    else {
      GeoJsonWriter writer = new GeoJsonWriter(16);
      writer.setEncodeCRS(false);
      g.writeRawValue(writer.write(Metric.transform(geometry, false)));
    }
    g.writeObjectFieldStart("properties");
    g.writeObjectField("id", id);
    g.writeStringField("object_type", type);
    g.writeStringField("variant_id", variant);
  }

  private void end(JsonGenerator g) throws IOException {
    g.writeEndObject();
    g.writeEndObject();
  }

  private static final class Ids {
    final Snapshot s;
    final String prefix;
    int count;

    Ids(Snapshot s, String v) {
      this.s = s;
      prefix = "optimus_" + v + "_";
    }

    JsonNode next() {
      String id;
      do {
        id = prefix + (++count);
      } while (s.byId.containsKey("s:" + id));
      return TextNode.valueOf(id);
    }
  }

  public static final class Limited extends FilterOutputStream {
    private long count;
    private final long max;

    public Limited(OutputStream out, long max) {
      super(out);
      this.max = max;
    }

    private void add(int n) throws IOException {
      if (n > max - count) throw new IOException("Result exceeds byte limit");
      count += n;
    }

    public void write(int b) throws IOException {
      add(1);
      out.write(b);
    }

    public void write(byte[] b, int off, int len) throws IOException {
      add(len);
      out.write(b, off, len);
    }
  }
}

package com.heatroute.geo;

import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;
import org.locationtech.proj4j.*;

public final class Metric {
  public static final GeometryFactory GF = new GeometryFactory(new PrecisionModel(), 32637);
  public static final double EPS = 1e-6;
  private static final ThreadLocal<CoordinateTransform[]> TRANSFORMS =
      ThreadLocal.withInitial(
          () -> {
            CRSFactory f = new CRSFactory();
            CoordinateReferenceSystem
                a = f.createFromParameters("WGS84", "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"),
                b =
                    f.createFromParameters(
                        "EPSG:32637", "+proj=utm +zone=37 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs");
            CoordinateTransformFactory t = new CoordinateTransformFactory();
            return new CoordinateTransform[] {t.createTransform(a, b), t.createTransform(b, a)};
          });

  public static Geometry transform(Geometry source, boolean forward) {
    Geometry g = source.copy();
    g.apply(
        (CoordinateFilter)
            c -> {
              ProjCoordinate q = new ProjCoordinate();
              TRANSFORMS.get()[forward ? 0 : 1].transform(new ProjCoordinate(c.x, c.y), q);
              c.x = q.x;
              c.y = q.y;
            });
    g.geometryChanged();
    g.setSRID(forward ? 32637 : 4326);
    return g;
  }

  public static Point point(Coordinate c) {
    return GF.createPoint(c.copy());
  }

  public static LineString line(Coordinate... c) {
    return GF.createLineString(c);
  }

  public static LineString part(LineString l, double a, double b) {
    return (LineString) new LengthIndexedLine(l).extractLine(a, b);
  }

  public static boolean straight(LineString l) {
    return l.getLength() <= l.getStartPoint().distance(l.getEndPoint()) + 1e-5;
  }

  public static boolean turn(Coordinate a, Coordinate b, Coordinate c) {
    return (b.x - a.x) * (c.x - b.x) + (b.y - a.y) * (c.y - b.y) >= -1e-7;
  }

  public static boolean turns(LineString l) {
    for (int i = 1; i < l.getNumPoints() - 1; i++)
      if (!turn(l.getCoordinateN(i - 1), l.getCoordinateN(i), l.getCoordinateN(i + 1)))
        return false;
    return true;
  }

  public static String key(Coordinate c) {
    return Double.toHexString(c.x) + ":" + Double.toHexString(c.y);
  }

  private Metric() {}
}

public final class DiameterCatalog {
  public static final class Row {

    public final BigDecimal capacity, rate;

    Row(int d, String c, double l, int r, double w, double h) {

      capacity = new BigDecimal(c);

      rate = BigDecimal.valueOf(r);
      width = w;

    }

  public static final List<Row> ALL =

          new Row(900, "7165", 6518, 327693, 2.450, 1.1),
          new Row(1000, "9391.8", 7419, 418777, 2.650, 1.2),
          new Row(1200, "15012.8", 9288, 428074, 3.100, 1.425),
          new Row(1400, "22501.9", 11276, 683417, 3.450, 1.6));

  public static Row get(int dn) {
    return ALL.stream()
        .filter(r -> r.dn == dn)
        .findFirst()
        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown DN " + dn));
  }

  public static Row select(BigDecimal flow, double length, int downstreamDn) {
    if (flow.signum() < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Negative flow");
    return ALL.stream()
        .filter(
            r ->
                r.capacity.compareTo(flow) >= 0
                    && r.maxLength + 1e-7 >= length
                    && r.dn >= downstreamDn)
        .findFirst()
        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("No diameter satisfies flow/length"));
  }

  private DiameterCatalog() {}
}

===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/hydraulic/TreeHydraulics.java BYTES 1639 SHA256 0c4da31da727ea80f4bdb45a46b5fad935dcab572f33c391895c939a75ae5df7 =====
package com.heatroute.hydraulic;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;

/** Exact minimum sizing for a star component, across chamber boundaries with equal DN. */
public final class TreeHydraulics {
  public Component size(Root root, Coordinate hub, LineString trunk, List<Branch> branches) {
    List<Branch> leaves = new ArrayList<>();
    BigDecimal total = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    int largest = 50;
    for (Branch b : branches) {
      int dn = DiameterCatalog.select(b.target.flow, b.line.getLength(), 0).dn;
      leaves.add(new Branch(b.target, b.line, dn));
      largest = Math.max(largest, dn);
      total = total.add(b.target.flow);
    }
    if (trunk == null) return new Component(root, null, null, 0, leaves);
    for (int i = 0; i < leaves.size(); i++) {
      Branch b = leaves.get(i);
      if (b.target.flow.compareTo(total) == 0) {
        int dn = DiameterCatalog.select(total, b.line.getLength() + trunk.getLength(), largest).dn;
        leaves.set(i, new Branch(b.target, b.line, dn));
        largest = Math.max(largest, dn);
      }
    }
    for (var r : DiameterCatalog.ALL) {
      if (r.dn < largest || r.capacity.compareTo(total) < 0 || r.maxLength < trunk.getLength())
        continue;
      boolean valid = true;
      for (Branch b : leaves)
        if (b.dn == r.dn && b.line.getLength() + trunk.getLength() > r.maxLength + 1e-7)
          valid = false;
      if (valid) return new Component(root, hub, trunk, r.dn, leaves);
    }
    throw new IllegalArgumentException("No diameter for continuous shared paths");
  }
}

===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/ingest/GeoJsonInput.java BYTES 7350 SHA256 6e7b2366e4a08585a4db80c7271783fa69b29ef240cf133cce3df73aee442948 =====
package com.heatroute.ingest;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.*;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.io.*;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.io.geojson.GeoJsonReader;

public final class GeoJsonInput {
  public static final ObjectMapper JSON =
      new ObjectMapper().enable(DeserializationFeature.USE_BIG_DECIMAL_FOR_FLOATS);
  public static final Set<String> RULES =
      Set.of(
          "oks",
          "park",
          "social_area",
          "prohibited_site",
          "water",
          "railway",
          "road",
          "tram_tracks",
          "gas_pipeline",
          "power_cable");

  public Snapshot read(InputStream input) throws IOException {
    List<Feature> fs = new ArrayList<>();
    stream(input, fs::add);
    Snapshot s = new Snapshot(fs);
    if (s.targets.isEmpty() || s.networks.isEmpty())
      throw new IOException("Required heat_network and oks_connection_point");
    return s;
  }

  public Snapshot read(InputStream input, java.nio.file.Path spool) throws IOException {
    GeometryStore store = new GeometryStore(spool);
    List<Feature> fs = new ArrayList<>();
    try {
      stream(
          input,
          f -> {
            try {
              fs.add(f.spooled(store));
            } catch (IOException e) {
              throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(e);
            }
          });
      Snapshot s = new Snapshot(fs).withStore(store);
      if (s.targets.isEmpty() || s.networks.isEmpty())
        throw new IOException("Required heat_network and oks_connection_point");
      return s;
    } catch (Exception e) {
      store.close();
      throw e;
    }
  }

  public long stream(InputStream input, Consumer<Feature> consumer) throws IOException {
    Set<String> ids = new HashSet<>();
    long count = 0;
    String type = null;
    boolean features = false;
    try (JsonParser p = JSON.getFactory().createParser(input)) {
      p.enable(JsonParser.Feature.STRICT_DUPLICATE_DETECTION);
      if (p.nextToken() != JsonToken.START_OBJECT)
        throw new IOException("Expected FeatureCollection");
      while (p.nextToken() != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
        if (p.currentToken() != JsonToken.FIELD_NAME)
          throw new IOException("Invalid JSON envelope");
        String field = p.currentName();
        p.nextToken();
        if (field.equals("type")) {
          type = p.getValueAsString();
          p.skipChildren();
        } else if (field.equals("crs")) {
          JsonNode crs = JSON.readTree(p);
          String name = crs.path("properties").path("name").asText();
          if (!Set.of("EPSG:4326", "urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326", "urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84")
              .contains(name)) throw new IOException("Input CRS must be WGS84");
        } else if (field.equals("features")) {
          features = true;
          if (p.currentToken() != JsonToken.START_ARRAY)
            throw new IOException("Expected features array");
          while (p.nextToken() != JsonToken.END_ARRAY) {
            if (p.currentToken() != JsonToken.START_OBJECT)
              throw new IOException("Expected feature");
            Feature f = parse(readFeature(p));
            if (!ids.add(f.key)) throw new IOException("Duplicate id " + f.id);
            consumer.accept(f);
            count++;
          }
        } else p.skipChildren();
      }
      if (!features || !"FeatureCollection".equals(type) || p.nextToken() != null)
        throw new IOException("Invalid FeatureCollection");
    }
    return count;
  }

  private JsonNode readFeature(JsonParser p) throws IOException {
    var feature = JSON.createObjectNode();
    while (p.nextToken() != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
      if (p.currentToken() != JsonToken.FIELD_NAME) throw new IOException("Invalid feature object");
      String field = p.currentName();
      p.nextToken();
      if (field.equals("geometry") || field.equals("type")) feature.set(field, JSON.readTree(p));
      else if (field.equals("properties")) {
        if (p.currentToken() != JsonToken.START_OBJECT)
          throw new IOException("Expected properties object");
        var properties = JSON.createObjectNode();
        while (p.nextToken() != JsonToken.END_OBJECT) {
          String key = p.currentName();
          p.nextToken();
          if (Set.of("id", "object_type", "restriction_type", "diameter", "flow_tph").contains(key))
            properties.set(key, JSON.readTree(p));
          else p.skipChildren();
        }
        feature.set("properties", properties);
      } else p.skipChildren();
    }
    return feature;
  }

  private Feature parse(JsonNode f) throws IOException {
    JsonNode p = f.path("properties"), id = p.path("id");
    String type = p.path("object_type").asText(), rt = p.path("restriction_type").asText("");
    if (!f.path("type").asText().equals("Feature")
        || !(id.isNumber() || id.isTextual())
        || (id.isTextual() && id.asText().isBlank()))
      throw new IOException("Feature requires string/number id");
    if (!Set.of("source", "heat_network", "heat_chamber", "oks_connection_point", "restriction")
        .contains(type)) throw new IOException("Unsupported object_type at " + id);
    try {
      Geometry g = new GeoJsonReader().read(f.path("geometry").toString());
      if (g.isEmpty() || !g.isValid()) throw new IOException("Invalid geometry at " + id);
      for (Coordinate c : g.getCoordinates())
        if (!Double.isFinite(c.x)
            || !Double.isFinite(c.y)
            || Math.abs(c.x) > 180
            || Math.abs(c.y) > 90
            || !Double.isNaN(c.getZ()))
          throw new IOException("Expected 2D WGS84 coordinates at " + id);
      if (Set.of("source", "heat_chamber", "oks_connection_point").contains(type)
          && !(g instanceof Point)) throw new IOException("Expected Point at " + id);
      int diameter = 0;
      BigDecimal flow = BigDecimal.ZERO;
      if (type.equals("heat_network")) {
        if (!(g instanceof LineString)
            || !g.isSimple()
            || g.getLength() == 0
            || !p.path("diameter").isIntegralNumber())
          throw new IOException("Invalid network at " + id);
        diameter = p.path("diameter").intValue();
        DiameterCatalog.get(diameter);
      }
      if (type.equals("oks_connection_point")) {
        if (!p.path("flow_tph").isNumber()) throw new IOException("Missing flow_tph at " + id);
        flow = p.get("flow_tph").decimalValue();
        if (flow.signum() < 0) throw new IOException("Negative flow at " + id);
      }
      if (type.equals("restriction")
          && (rt.isBlank()
              || !(g instanceof LineString
                  || g instanceof MultiLineString
                  || g instanceof Polygon
                  || g instanceof MultiPolygon)))
        throw new IOException("Invalid restriction at " + id);
      return new Feature(id, type, rt, Metric.transform(g, true), diameter, flow);
    } catch (org.locationtech.jts.io.ParseException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
      throw new IOException("Invalid feature " + id + ": " + e.getMessage(), e);
    }
  }
}

package com.heatroute.ingest;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.Geometry;
import org.locationtech.jts.io.*;

/** Per-job geometry spool. Metadata/envelopes stay in memory; geometry has a bounded LRU. */
public final class GeometryStore implements AutoCloseable {
  private final FileChannel channel;
  private final Path path;
  private long offset, weight;
  private final LinkedHashMap<Long, Geometry> cache = new LinkedHashMap<>(128, .75f, true);

  public GeometryStore(Path path) throws IOException {
    this.path = path;
    channel =
        FileChannel.open(
            path,
            StandardOpenOption.CREATE,
            StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING,
            StandardOpenOption.READ,
            StandardOpenOption.WRITE);
  }

  public static final class Ref {
    final long offset;
    final int bytes;

    Ref(long o, int b) {
      offset = o;
      bytes = b;
    }
  }

  public synchronized Ref put(Geometry g) throws IOException {
    byte[] bytes = new WKBWriter(2, true).write(g);
    Ref ref = new Ref(offset, bytes.length);
    ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes);
    while (b.hasRemaining()) channel.write(b, offset + b.position());
    offset += bytes.length;
    return ref;
  }

  public synchronized Geometry get(Ref ref) {
    Geometry value = cache.get(ref.offset);
    if (value != null) return value;
    try {
      ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(ref.bytes);
      while (b.hasRemaining()) {
        int n = channel.read(b, ref.offset + b.position());
        if (n < 0) throw new EOFException("Truncated geometry spool");
      }
      value = new WKBReader().read(b.array());
      cache.put(ref.offset, value);
      weight += Math.max(ref.bytes, value.getNumPoints() * 48L + 256);
      Iterator<Map.Entry<Long, Geometry>> it = cache.entrySet().iterator();
      while ((cache.size() > 2000 || weight > 64L * 1024 * 1024) && cache.size() > 1) {
        var e = it.next();
        weight -=
            Math.max(
                new WKBWriter(2, true).write(e.getValue()).length,
                e.getValue().getNumPoints() * 48L + 256);
        it.remove();
      }
      return value;
    } catch (IOException | ParseException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException("Geometry spool read failed", e);
    }
  }

  public synchronized void close() throws IOException {
    cache.clear();
    channel.close();
    Files.deleteIfExists(path);
  }
}

package com.heatroute.persistence;

import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@Profile("!postgres")
public class FileJobStore implements JobStore {
  private final Path root;

  public FileJobStore(@Value("${optimus.storage}") String root) throws IOException {
    this.root = Path.of(root, "jobs");
    Files.createDirectories(this.root);
  }

  public synchronized void save(String id, Map<String, Object> state) {
    try {
      Path tmp = Files.createTempFile(root, "job-", ".tmp");
      GeoJsonInput.JSON.writeValue(tmp.toFile(), state);
      Files.move(
          tmp,
          root.resolve(id + ".json"),
          StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,
          StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    } catch (IOException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }

  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  public synchronized Map<String, Object> get(String id) {
    try {
      return GeoJsonInput.JSON.readValue(root.resolve(id + ".json").toFile(), Map.class);
    } catch (IOException e) {
      throw new NoSuchElementException("Calculation not found");
    }
  }

  public List<Map<String, Object>> list() {
    List<Map<String, Object>> list = new ArrayList<>();
    try (var stream = Files.list(root)) {
      stream
          .filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".json"))
          .forEach(p -> list.add(get(p.getFileName().toString().replace(".json", ""))));
    } catch (IOException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
    list.sort(Comparator.comparing(m -> m.get("created").toString(), Comparator.reverseOrder()));
    return list.subList(0, Math.min(100, list.size()));
  }
}

package com.heatroute.persistence;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.Snapshot;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.io.WKBWriter;
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Profile;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

@Component
@Profile("postgres")
public class PostgresJobStore implements JobStore {
  private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

  public PostgresJobStore(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
    this.jdbc = jdbc;
  }

  public void save(String id, Map<String, Object> state) {
    try {
      jdbc.update(
          "INSERT INTO calculation(id,state) VALUES (?::uuid,?::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE"
              + " SET state=excluded.state",
          id,
          GeoJsonInput.JSON.writeValueAsString(state));
    } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }

  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
  private Map<String, Object> decode(String s) {
    try {
      return GeoJsonInput.JSON.readValue(s, Map.class);
    } catch (java.io.IOException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e);
    }
  }

  public Map<String, Object> get(String id) {
    var rows =
        jdbc.query(
            "SELECT state::text FROM calculation WHERE id=?::uuid",
            (rs, n) -> decode(rs.getString(1)),
            id);
    if (rows.isEmpty()) throw new NoSuchElementException("Calculation not found");
    return rows.get(0);
  }

  public List<Map<String, Object>> list() {
    return jdbc.query(
        "SELECT state::text FROM calculation ORDER BY created DESC LIMIT 100",
        (rs, n) -> decode(rs.getString(1)));
  }

  @org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional
  public void dataset(String id, Snapshot s) {
    jdbc.update("DELETE FROM input_feature WHERE calculation_id=?::uuid", id);
    jdbc.batchUpdate(
        "INSERT INTO"
            + " input_feature(calculation_id,id_key,original_id,object_type,restriction_type,diameter,flow_tph,geom)"
            + " VALUES (?::uuid,?,?::jsonb,?,?,?,?,ST_GeomFromEWKB(?))",
        s.features,
        500,
        (ps, f) -> {
          ps.setString(1, id);
          ps.setString(2, f.key);
          ps.setString(3, f.id.toString());
          ps.setString(4, f.type);
          ps.setString(5, f.restriction);
          ps.setInt(6, f.diameter);
          ps.setBigDecimal(7, f.flow);
          ps.setBytes(8, new WKBWriter(2, true).write(f.geometry()));
        });
  }
}

package com.heatroute.routing;

import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.distance.DistanceOp;

/** Reverse terminal planning. Computes continuous outer-end intervals, not a fixed extension.
 * Intervals describe clearance from the own building only. Every emitted terminal segment
 * is separately checked against ALL constraints before routing may use it.
 */
public final class TerminalEntryPlanner {
  private final Snapshot snapshot;
  private final ConstraintEngine rules;
  private final Map<String, Plan> cache = new TreeMap<>();
  private final Map<String,List<Coordinate>> legalGateCache=new TreeMap<>();
  public TerminalEntryPlanner(Snapshot snapshot, ConstraintEngine rules) {
    this.snapshot=snapshot; this.rules=rules;
  }
  public static final class Plan {
    public Feature target, owner;
    public Coordinate boundary;
    public double ux,uy,insideLength,clearance,horizon;
    public final List<double[]> intervals=new ArrayList<>();
    public String status;
    public Coordinate point(double t) { return new Coordinate(boundary.x+ux*t,boundary.y+uy*t); }
  }
  public Plan plan(Feature target,int dn) {
    String key=target.key+"/"+dn;
    if(cache.containsKey(key))return cache.get(key);
    Plan p=new Plan();p.target=target;
    for(Feature f:snapshot.nearby(target.envelope))
      if(f.restriction.equals("oks") && f.geometry().getDimension()==2 && f.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) {p.owner=f;break;}
    if(p.owner==null){p.status="NO_OWN_POLYGON";cache.put(key,p);return p;}
    Coordinate end=target.geometry().getCoordinate();
    p.boundary=DistanceOp.nearestPoints(p.owner.geometry().getBoundary(),target.geometry())[0];
    p.insideLength=p.boundary.distance(end);
    if(p.insideLength<1e-8){p.status="TARGET_ON_BOUNDARY_REQUIRES_DIRECTION_SEARCH";cache.put(key,p);return p;}
    p.ux=(p.boundary.x-end.x)/p.insideLength;p.uy=(p.boundary.y-end.y)/p.insideLength;
    p.clearance=ConstraintEngine.gap("oks",dn)+DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width/2;
    p.horizon=Math.max(0,DiameterCatalog.get(dn).maxLength-p.insideLength);
    if(p.horizon<1e-8){p.status="DIAMETER_LENGTH_LIMIT";cache.put(key,p);return p;}
    Geometry cross=Metric.line(p.boundary,p.point(p.horizon)).intersection(p.owner.geometry());
    for(int k=0;k<cross.getNumGeometries();k++) {
      Geometry part=cross.getGeometryN(k);double lo=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY,hi=0;
      for(Coordinate c:part.getCoordinates()) {double t=(c.x-p.boundary.x)*p.ux+(c.y-p.boundary.y)*p.uy;lo=Math.min(lo,t);hi=Math.max(hi,t);}
      if(hi<=1e-5)continue;
      if(lo<=1e-5 && part.getLength()>1e-4) p.horizon=0;
      else p.horizon=Math.min(p.horizon,lo);
    }
    List<double[]> blocked=new ArrayList<>();
    Geometry rings=p.owner.geometry().getBoundary();
    for(int k=0;k<rings.getNumGeometries();k++) {
      Coordinate[] cs=rings.getGeometryN(k).getCoordinates();
      for(int j=1;j<cs.length;j++) blockCapsule(p,cs[j-1],cs[j],blocked);
    }
    blocked.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble(x->x[0]));
    double cursor=0;
    for(double[] x:blocked) {
      if(x[0]>cursor+1e-7)p.intervals.add(new double[]{cursor,x[0]});
      cursor=Math.max(cursor,x[1]);
    }
    if(cursor<p.horizon-1e-7)p.intervals.add(new double[]{cursor,p.horizon});
    p.status=p.intervals.isEmpty()?"NO_OWN_CLEARANCE_INTERVAL":"OUTER_INTERVALS_FOUND";
    cache.put(key,p);return p;
  }
  private static void blockCapsule(Plan p,Coordinate a,Coordinate b,List<double[]> out) {
    double ex=b.x-a.x,ey=b.y-a.y,den=ex*ex+ey*ey;
    double wx=p.boundary.x-a.x,wy=p.boundary.y-a.y;
    double q0=den==0?0:(wx*ex+wy*ey)/den;
    double qv=den==0?0:(p.ux*ex+p.uy*ey)/den;
    TreeSet<Double> cuts=new TreeSet<>();cuts.add(0.0);cuts.add(p.horizon);
    if(Math.abs(qv)>1e-18)for(double t:new double[]{-q0/qv,(1-q0)/qv})if(t>0&&t<p.horizon)cuts.add(t);
    List<Double> points=new ArrayList<>(cuts);
    for(int i=1;i<points.size();i++) {
      double lo=points.get(i-1),hi=points.get(i),q=q0+qv*(lo+hi)/2;
      double x=wx,y=wy,dx=p.ux,dy=p.uy;
      if(q>=1){x-=ex;y-=ey;}
      else if(q>0){x-=q0*ex;y-=q0*ey;dx-=qv*ex;dy-=qv*ey;}
      double aa=dx*dx+dy*dy,bb=x*dx+y*dy,cc=x*x+y*y-p.clearance*p.clearance;
      if(aa<1e-18){
        if(Math.abs(bb)<1e-14){if(cc<0)out.add(new double[]{lo,hi});}
        else {double root=-cc/(2*bb);double l=bb>0?lo:Math.max(lo,root),h=bb>0?Math.min(hi,root):hi;if(h>l)out.add(new double[]{l,h});}
      } else {
        double disc=bb*bb-aa*cc;
        if(disc<=0)continue;
        double sq=Math.sqrt(disc),l=Math.max(lo,(-bb-sq)/aa),h=Math.min(hi,(-bb+sq)/aa);
        if(h>l)out.add(new double[]{l,h});
      }
    }
  }
  public List<Coordinate> legalGates(Feature target,int dn) {
    String key=target.key+"/"+dn;
    if(legalGateCache.containsKey(key))return legalGateCache.get(key);
    Plan p=plan(target,dn);List<Coordinate> gates=new ArrayList<>();
    if(p.boundary==null || p.insideLength<1e-8){legalGateCache.put(key,gates);return gates;}
    List<Double> projections=new ArrayList<>();
    for(Feature network:snapshot.nearestNetworks(target.geometry().getCoordinate(),8)) {
      Coordinate q=DistanceOp.nearestPoints(network.geometry(),target.geometry())[0];
      projections.add((q.x-p.boundary.x)*p.ux+(q.y-p.boundary.y)*p.uy);
    }
    for(double[] interval:p.intervals) {
      double lo=interval[0]+1e-4,hi=interval[1]-1e-4;if(hi<lo)continue;
      TreeSet<Double> ts=new TreeSet<>();ts.add(lo);ts.add(hi);ts.add((lo+hi)/2);
      for(double projection:projections)ts.add(Math.max(lo,Math.min(hi,projection)));
      for(double step:new double[]{.02,.12,.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128})if(lo+step<hi)ts.add(lo+step);
      for(double t:ts) {
        Coordinate gate=p.point(t);
        if(p.owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(gate))<p.clearance-1e-6)continue;
        if(rules.assess(Metric.line(gate,target.geometry().getCoordinate()),dn,Set.of(),target).valid())gates.add(gate);
      }
    }
    legalGateCache.put(key,gates);return gates;
  }
  public List<Coordinate> gates(Feature target,int dn,Coordinate source) {
    List<Coordinate> usable=new ArrayList<>();
    for(Coordinate gate:legalGates(target,dn))
      if(gate.distance(source)+gate.distance(target.geometry().getCoordinate())<=DiameterCatalog.get(dn).maxLength+1e-6)usable.add(gate);
    return usable;
  }
  public List<Map<String,Object>> diagnostics() {
    List<Map<String,Object>> rows=new ArrayList<>();
    for(Feature target:snapshot.targets) {
      int dn=DiameterCatalog.select(target.flow,0,0).dn;Plan p=plan(target,dn);Map<String,Object> d=new LinkedHashMap<>();
      d.put("targetId",target.id);d.put("diameterLowerBound",dn);d.put("status",p.status);
      if(p.owner!=null){d.put("ownBuildingId",p.owner.id);d.put("clearanceM",p.clearance);d.put("insideLengthM",p.insideLength);d.put("outwardRayLimitM",p.horizon);d.put("outerEndpointIntervalsM",p.intervals);}
      List<List<Double>> endpoints=new ArrayList<>();
      for(Coordinate gate:legalGates(target,dn)) {
        Coordinate wgs=Metric.transform(Metric.point(gate),false).getCoordinate();
        endpoints.add(List.of(wgs.x,wgs.y));
      }
      d.put("validatedOuterEndpointsWgs84",endpoints);
      d.put("validatedEndpointCount",endpoints.size());
      d.put("intervalScope","Continuous own-building clearance; emitted endpoints additionally pass all terminal-segment constraints; candidate sampling is finite");
      rows.add(d);
    }
    return rows;
  }
}

package com.heatroute.routing;

import com.heatroute.constraints.ConstraintEngine;
import com.heatroute.constraints.EntryPolicy;
import com.heatroute.cost.CostFunction;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.DiameterCatalog;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.buffer.BufferOp;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.buffer.BufferParameters;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.distance.DistanceOp;
import org.locationtech.jts.operation.union.UnaryUnionOp;
import org.locationtech.jts.simplify.DouglasPeuckerSimplifier;

public final class VisibilityRouter {
  private final ConstraintEngine rules;
  private final Snapshot snapshot;
  private final TerminalEntryPlanner terminalPlanner;
  private final Map<String, Optional<LineString>> cache =
      new LinkedHashMap<String, Optional<LineString>>(256, .75f, true) {
        protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Optional<LineString>> e) {
          return size() > 2000;
        }
      };
  public long cacheHits, edgeChecks;
  public final Map<String, Integer> rejected = new TreeMap<>();

  public VisibilityRouter(Snapshot s, ConstraintEngine c) {
    snapshot = s;
    rules = c;
    terminalPlanner = new TerminalEntryPlanner(s,c);
  }

  public List<Map<String,Object>> prepareTerminalEntries() {
    if (!EntryPolicy.nearestOnly()) {
      List<Map<String,Object>> plans = new ArrayList<>();
      for (Feature target : snapshot.targets) {
        int dn = DiameterCatalog.select(target.flow, 0, 0).dn;
        Feature owner = null;
        for (Feature f : snapshot.nearby(target.envelope))
          if (f.restriction.equals("oks") && f.geometry().getDimension() == 2
              && f.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) { owner = f; break; }
        Map<String,Object> plan = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        plan.put("targetId", target.id);
        plan.put("diameterLowerBound", dn);
        List<List<Double>> endpoints = new ArrayList<>();
        if (owner != null) {
          plan.put("ownBuildingId", owner.id);
          for (Coordinate gate : entries(owner, target, dn)) {
            Coordinate wgs = Metric.transform(Metric.point(gate), false).getCoordinate();
            endpoints.add(List.of(wgs.x, wgs.y));
          }
        }
        plan.put("status", owner == null ? "NO_OWN_POLYGON" : endpoints.isEmpty()
            ? "NO_SAMPLED_ADMISSIBLE_ENTRY" : "ADMISSIBLE_ENTRIES_FOUND");
        plan.put("entryPolicy", EntryPolicy.name());
        plan.put("validatedOuterEndpointsWgs84", endpoints);
        plan.put("validatedEndpointCount", endpoints.size());
        plan.put("candidateScope", "Geometry-derived facade samples at minimum flow diameter; "
            + "all terminal-segment checks except global nearest-boundary requirement; "
            + "full-route feasibility and diameter are rechecked after routing; finite search");
        plans.add(plan);
      }
      return plans;
    }
    for(Feature target:snapshot.targets)
      for(var row:DiameterCatalog.ALL)
        if(row.capacity.compareTo(target.flow)>=0)terminalPlanner.legalGates(target,row.dn);
    return terminalPlanner.diagnostics();
  }

  public LineString route(
      Coordinate start, Coordinate end, int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    String key =
        Metric.key(start)
            + "/"
            + Metric.key(end)
            + "/"
            + dn
            + "/"
            + new TreeSet<>(incident)
            + "/"
            + (target == null ? "" : target.key);
    Optional<LineString> memo = cache.get(key);
    if (memo != null) {
      cacheHits++;
      return memo.map(g -> (LineString) g.copy()).orElse(null);
    }
    LineString result = chooseEntry(start, end, dn, incident, target, true);
    cache.put(key, Optional.ofNullable(result));
    return result;
  }

  public LineString fast(
      Coordinate start, Coordinate end, int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    String key =
        "fast/"
            + Metric.key(start)
            + "/"
            + Metric.key(end)
            + "/"
            + dn
            + "/"
            + new TreeSet<>(incident)
            + "/"
            + (target == null ? "" : target.key);
    Optional<LineString> memo = cache.get(key);
    if (memo != null) {
      cacheHits++;
      return memo.map(g -> (LineString) g.copy()).orElse(null);
    }
    LineString result = chooseEntry(start, end, dn, incident, target, false);
    cache.put(key, Optional.ofNullable(result));
    return result;
  }

  private final Map<String, List<Coordinate>> entryCache = new HashMap<>();

  private BigDecimal price(LineString line, int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    var check = rules.assess(line, dn, incident, target);
    BigDecimal total = BigDecimal.ZERO;
    for (var part : rules.partition(line, check.spans))
      total = total.add(CostFunction.pipe(part.b - part.a, dn, part.factor));
    return total;
  }

  private LineString cheaper(LineString a, LineString b, int dn,
      Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    if (b == null) return a;
    if (a == null) return b;
    int cmp = price(a, dn, incident, target).compareTo(price(b, dn, incident, target));
    if (cmp != 0) return cmp < 0 ? a : b;
    cmp = Double.compare(a.getLength(), b.getLength());
    if (cmp != 0) return cmp < 0 ? a : b;
    return a.toText().compareTo(b.toText()) <= 0 ? a : b;
  }

  /** Facade samples are geometry-derived, with no dataset-specific coordinates or IDs. */
  private List<Coordinate> entries(Feature owner, Feature target, int dn) {
    String key = target.key + "/" + owner.key + "/" + dn;
    if (entryCache.containsKey(key)) return entryCache.get(key);
    Coordinate end = target.geometry().getCoordinate();
    TreeMap<String, Coordinate> boundaryPoints = new TreeMap<>();
    Geometry boundary = owner.geometry().getBoundary();
    for (int k = 0; k < boundary.getNumGeometries(); k++) {
      Coordinate[] cs = boundary.getGeometryN(k).getCoordinates();
      for (int i = 1; i < cs.length; i++) {
        LineSegment seg = new LineSegment(cs[i - 1], cs[i]);
        Coordinate nearest = seg.closestPoint(end);
        boundaryPoints.put(Metric.key(nearest), nearest);
        int samples = Math.min(32, Math.max(2, (int) Math.ceil(seg.getLength() / 8)));
        for (int j = 0; j <= samples; j++) {
          Coordinate c = seg.pointAlong((double) j / samples);
          boundaryPoints.put(Metric.key(c), c);
        }
      }
    }
    double clearance = ConstraintEngine.gap("oks", dn) + DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width / 2;
    TreeMap<String, Coordinate> portals = new TreeMap<>();
    for (Coordinate b : boundaryPoints.values()) {
      double length = b.distance(end);
      if (length < 1e-7) continue;
      double dx = (b.x - end.x) / length, dy = (b.y - end.y) / length;
      // Extend the straight entry beyond the building's clearance envelope.
      for (double extension = clearance + .15; extension <= clearance * 5; extension += clearance / 2) {
        Coordinate a = new Coordinate(b.x + dx * extension, b.y + dy * extension);
        if (owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(a)) < clearance + .01) continue;
        if (valid(Metric.line(a, end), dn, Set.of(), target)) portals.put(Metric.key(a), a);
        break;
      }
    }
    List<Coordinate> result = new ArrayList<>(portals.values());
    entryCache.put(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  private LineString chooseEntry(Coordinate start, Coordinate end, int dn,
      Set<String> incident, Feature target, boolean deep) {
    if (EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() || target == null)
      return compute(start, end, dn, incident, target, deep);
    Feature owner = null;
    for (Feature f : snapshot.nearby(target.envelope))
      if (f.restriction.equals("oks") && f.geometry().getDimension() == 2
          && f.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) { owner = f; break; }
    if (owner == null) return compute(start, end, dn, incident, target, deep);
    double limit = DiameterCatalog.get(dn).maxLength;
    LineString best = compute(start, end, dn, incident, target, false);
    LineString direct = Metric.line(start, end);
    if (direct.getLength() <= limit && valid(direct, dn, incident, target)) best = direct;
    List<Coordinate> candidates = new ArrayList<>(entries(owner, target, dn));
    candidates.sort(Comparator.comparingDouble((Coordinate c) -> start.distance(c) + c.distance(end))
        .thenComparing(Metric::key));
    int fastChecks = 0;
    BigDecimal bestPrice = best == null ? null : price(best, dn, incident, target);
    for (Coordinate a : candidates) {
      if (start.distance(a) + a.distance(end) > limit || !Metric.turn(start, a, end)) continue;
      if (bestPrice != null && CostFunction.pipe(start.distance(a)+a.distance(end),dn,1)
          .compareTo(bestPrice) >= 0) continue;
      if (fastChecks++ >= 64) break;
      LineString line = Metric.line(start, a, end);
      if (valid(line, dn, incident, target)) {
        best = cheaper(best, line, dn, incident, target);
        bestPrice = price(best, dn, incident, target);
      }
    }
    if (!deep) return best;
    // One search with several admissible terminal portals, instead of an A* per facade.
    List<Coordinate> goals = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Coordinate a : candidates) {
      double lower = start.distance(a) + a.distance(end);
      if (lower > limit) continue;
      if (best != null && CostFunction.pipe(lower, dn, 1)
          .compareTo(price(best, dn, incident, target)) >= 0) continue;
      goals.add(a);
      if (goals.size() >= 64) break;
    }
    if (!goals.isEmpty())
      for (double radius : new double[] {Math.max(40, start.distance(end)*.45),
          Math.max(150, start.distance(end)*1.2)}) {
        LineString line = searchPortals(start, goals, end, dn, incident, target, radius);
        best = cheaper(best, line, dn, incident, target);
        if (line != null) break;
      }
    return best;
  }

  private LineString compute(
      Coordinate start,
      Coordinate end,
      int dn,
      Set<String> incident,
      Feature target,
      boolean search) {
    if (start.distance(end) < 1e-5) return null;
    double limit = DiameterCatalog.get(dn).maxLength;
    if (start.distance(end) > limit) return null;
    LineString direct = Metric.line(start, end);
    if (valid(direct, dn, incident, target)) return direct;
    if(EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && target!=null) {
      var terminalPlan=terminalPlanner.plan(target,dn);
      if(terminalPlan.owner!=null && terminalPlan.insideLength>1e-8) {
        List<Coordinate> goals=terminalPlanner.gates(target,dn,start);
        LineString best=null;
        for(Coordinate gate:goals) {
          LineString candidate=Metric.line(start,gate,end);
          if(Metric.turn(start,gate,end) && valid(candidate,dn,incident,target))
            best=cheaper(best,candidate,dn,incident,target);
        }
        if(best!=null || !search || goals.isEmpty())return best;
        for(double radius:new double[]{Math.max(40,start.distance(end)*.45),Math.max(150,start.distance(end)*1.2)}) {
          LineString path=searchPortals(start,goals,end,dn,incident,target,radius);
          if(path!=null)return path;
        }
        return null;
      }
    }
    Coordinate destination = end;
    Feature owner = null;
    if (target != null) {
      for (Feature f : snapshot.nearby(target.envelope))
        if (f.restriction.equals("oks")
            && f.geometry().getDimension() == 2
            && f.geometry().covers(target.geometry())) {
          owner = f;
          break;
        }
      if (owner != null) {
        Coordinate boundary =
            DistanceOp.nearestPoints(owner.geometry().getBoundary(), target.geometry())[0];
        double dx = boundary.x - end.x, dy = boundary.y - end.y, len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (len < 1e-8) {
          Coordinate center = owner.geometry().getInteriorPoint().getCoordinate();
          dx = end.x - center.x;
          dy = end.y - center.y;
          len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        }
        if (len < 1e-8) return null;
        double clearance = ConstraintEngine.gap("oks", dn) + DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width / 2;
        double extension = clearance + .12;
        destination =
            new Coordinate(boundary.x + dx / len * extension, boundary.y + dy / len * extension);
        for (int step = 0;
            step < 30 && owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(destination)) < clearance + .02;
            step++) {
          extension += Math.max(.25, clearance / 4);
          destination =
              new Coordinate(boundary.x + dx / len * extension, boundary.y + dy / len * extension);
        }
        if (owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(destination)) < clearance
            && !(EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && search)) return null;
        if (!valid(Metric.line(destination, end), dn, Set.of(), target)
            && !(EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && search)) return null;
      }
    }
    // Search several last-bend positions on the SAME mandatory nearest-entry ray.
    // Candidate spacing is a search budget, never a minimum permitted segment length.
    if (owner != null && EntryPolicy.nearestOnly() && search) {
      Coordinate boundary = DistanceOp.nearestPoints(owner.geometry().getBoundary(), target.geometry())[0];
      double length = boundary.distance(end);
      if (length > 1e-8) {
        double ux = (boundary.x-end.x)/length, uy = (boundary.y-end.y)/length;
        double clearance = ConstraintEngine.gap("oks", dn) + DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width/2;
        TreeSet<Double> offsets = new TreeSet<>();
        offsets.add(destination.distance(boundary));
        offsets.add(clearance + .0001);
        double projection = (start.x-boundary.x)*ux + (start.y-boundary.y)*uy;
        if (projection > 0) offsets.add(projection);
        for (double extra : new double[]{.02,.12,.5,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128})
          offsets.add(clearance + extra);
        List<Coordinate> goals = new ArrayList<>();
        for (double offset : offsets) {
          Coordinate goal = new Coordinate(boundary.x+ux*offset,boundary.y+uy*offset);
          if (goal.distance(end)+goal.distance(start)>limit) continue;
          if (owner.geometry().distance(Metric.point(goal)) < clearance-1e-6) continue;
          if (!valid(Metric.line(goal,end),dn,Set.of(),target)) continue;
          goals.add(goal);
        }
        LineString best = null;
        for (Coordinate goal : goals) {
          LineString candidate = Metric.line(start,goal,end);
          if (!Metric.turn(start,goal,end) || !valid(candidate,dn,incident,target)) continue;
          best = cheaper(best,candidate,dn,incident,target);
        }
        if (best != null) return best;
        if (goals.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (double radius : new double[]{Math.max(40,start.distance(destination)*.45),Math.max(150,start.distance(destination)*1.2)}) {
          LineString path=searchPortals(start,goals,end,dn,incident,target,radius);
          if(path!=null) return path;
        }
        return null;
      }
    }
    if (destination.distance(end) > 1e-6 && Metric.turn(start, destination, end)) {
      LineString approach = Metric.line(start, destination, end);
      if (approach.getLength() <= limit && valid(approach, dn, incident, target)) return approach;
    }
    if (!search) return null;
    for (double radius :
        new double[] {
          Math.max(40, start.distance(destination) * .45),
          Math.max(150, start.distance(destination) * 1.2)
        }) {
      LineString path = search(start, destination, end, dn, incident, target, radius);
      if (path != null) return path;
    }
    return null;
  }

  private LineString search(
      Coordinate start,
      Coordinate destination,
      Coordinate terminal,
      int dn,
      Set<String> incident,
      Feature target,
      double radius) {
    return searchPortals(start, List.of(destination), terminal, dn, incident, target, radius);
  }

  private LineString searchPortals(Coordinate start, List<Coordinate> goals, Coordinate terminal,
      int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target, double radius) {
    double max = DiameterCatalog.get(dn).maxLength;
    Envelope region = new Envelope(start, terminal);
    for (Coordinate goal : goals) region.expandToInclude(goal);
    region.expandBy(radius);
    TreeMap<String, Coordinate> unique = new TreeMap<>();
    List<Geometry> forbiddenBuffers = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Geometry> boundaries = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Feature f : snapshot.nearby(region)) {
      String type = f.type.equals("heat_network") ? "heat_network" : f.restriction;
      if (!ConstraintEngine.forbidden(type) && ConstraintEngine.factor(type) == 1) continue;
      double offset =
          ConstraintEngine.gap(type, dn)
              + DiameterCatalog.get(dn).width / 2
              + ConstraintEngine.halfOther(f)
              + .60;
      if (!ConstraintEngine.forbidden(type)) offset += 3;
      BufferParameters bufferParameters =
          new BufferParameters(4, BufferParameters.CAP_SQUARE, BufferParameters.JOIN_MITRE, 5);
      Geometry boundary =
          DouglasPeuckerSimplifier.simplify(
              BufferOp.bufferOp(f.geometry(), offset, bufferParameters), .5);
      if (ConstraintEngine.forbidden(type)) forbiddenBuffers.add(boundary);
      else boundaries.add(boundary);
    }
    if (!forbiddenBuffers.isEmpty()) boundaries.add(UnaryUnionOp.union(forbiddenBuffers));
    for (Geometry boundary : boundaries)
      for (Coordinate c : boundary.getCoordinates())
        if (c.distance(start) + c.distance(terminal) <= max
            && region.contains(c)) unique.putIfAbsent(Metric.key(c), c);
    List<Coordinate> candidates = new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
    candidates.sort(
        Comparator.comparingDouble((Coordinate c) -> c.distance(start) + c.distance(terminal))
            .thenComparing(Metric::key));
    if (candidates.size() > 240) candidates = new ArrayList<>(candidates.subList(0, 240));
    List<Coordinate> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
    nodes.add(start);
    nodes.addAll(goals);
    nodes.addAll(candidates);
    int n = nodes.size();
    double[] finalWeights = new double[goals.size()];
    for (int i = 0; i < goals.size(); i++) {
      Coordinate goal = goals.get(i);
      if (goal.distance(terminal) <= 1e-6) continue;
      var leg = Metric.line(goal, terminal);
      var check = rules.assess(leg, dn, Set.of(), target);
      if (!check.valid()) finalWeights[i] = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      else for (var part : rules.partition(leg, check.spans))
        finalWeights[i] += (part.b - part.a) * part.factor;
    }
    java.util.function.ToDoubleFunction<Coordinate> heuristic = point -> {
      double lower = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
      for (int i = 0; i < goals.size(); i++)
        lower = Math.min(lower, point.distance(goals.get(i)) + finalWeights[i]);
      return lower;
    };
    Map<Long, Double> edges = new HashMap<>();
    class State {
      final long id, serial;
      final double g, h, metres;
      final State parent;
      boolean active = true;
      State(long id, long serial, double g, double h, double metres, State parent) {
        this.id = id; this.serial = serial; this.g = g; this.h = h;
        this.metres = metres; this.parent = parent;
      }
    }
    // Keep both price and physical length: a cheaper but longer prefix cannot
    // dominate a shorter prefix near the hydraulic length limit.
    Map<Long, List<State>> labels = new HashMap<>();
    PriorityQueue<State> queue = new PriorityQueue<>(
        Comparator.comparingDouble((State x) -> x.g + x.h)
            .thenComparingDouble(x -> x.g).thenComparingLong(x -> x.id)
            .thenComparingLong(x -> x.serial));
    State initial = new State(0, 0, 0, heuristic.applyAsDouble(start), 0, null);
    queue.add(initial);
    labels.put(0L, new ArrayList<>(List.of(initial)));
    long serial = 1;
    int expanded = 0;
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && expanded++ < 4000) {
      State state = queue.poll();
      if (!state.active) continue;
      int prev = (int) (state.id / n) - 1, u = (int) (state.id % n);
      Coordinate point = nodes.get(u);
      if (u >= 1 && u <= goals.size()) {
        Coordinate destination = point;
        if (destination.distance(terminal) > 1e-6 && prev >= 0
            && !Metric.turn(nodes.get(prev), point, terminal)) continue;
        List<Coordinate> coords = new ArrayList<>();
        for (State at = state; at != null; at = at.parent)
          coords.add(nodes.get((int) (at.id % n)));
        Collections.reverse(coords);
        if (destination.distance(terminal) > 1e-6) coords.add(terminal);
        LineString route = Metric.line(coords.toArray(new Coordinate[0]));
        if (route.getLength() <= max + 1e-6 && valid(route, dn, incident, target)) return route;
        continue;
      }
      for (int v = 1; v < n; v++) {
        if (v == u || v == prev) continue;
        Coordinate next = nodes.get(v);
        double len = point.distance(next);
        if (len < .01 || state.metres + len + next.distance(terminal) > max) continue;
        if (prev >= 0 && !Metric.turn(nodes.get(prev), point, next)) continue;
        long edge = (long) u * n + v;
        Double weight = edges.get(edge);
        if (weight == null) {
          LineString segment = Metric.line(point, next);
          var check = rules.assess(segment, dn, u == 0 ? incident : Set.of(), null);
          edgeChecks++;
          if (!check.valid()) {
            rejected.merge(check.error.split(":", 2)[0], 1, Integer::sum);
            weight = Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
          } else {
            // Cost in equivalent metres; base tariff is fixed for this DN.
            weight = 0.0;
            for (var part : rules.partition(segment, check.spans))
              weight += (part.b - part.a) * part.factor;
          }
          edges.put(edge, weight);
        }
        if (!Double.isFinite(weight)) continue;
        long id = (long) (u + 1) * n + v;
        double g = state.g + weight, metres = state.metres + len;
        List<State> front = labels.computeIfAbsent(id, k -> new ArrayList<>());
        boolean dominated = false;
        for (State old : front)
          if (old.g <= g + 1e-8 && old.metres <= metres + 1e-8) { dominated = true; break; }
        if (dominated) continue;
        for (Iterator<State> it = front.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
          State old = it.next();
          if (g <= old.g + 1e-8 && metres <= old.metres + 1e-8) {
            old.active = false; it.remove();
          }
        }
        State nextState = new State(id, serial++, g, v <= goals.size() ? finalWeights[v-1] : heuristic.applyAsDouble(next), metres, state);
        front.add(nextState);
        queue.add(nextState);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  private boolean valid(LineString g, int dn, Set<String> incident, Feature target) {
    edgeChecks++;
    var c = rules.assess(g, dn, incident, target);
    if (!c.valid()) rejected.merge(c.error.split(":", 2)[0], 1, Integer::sum);
    return c.valid();
  }
}

===== FILE backend/src/main/java/com/heatroute/tiein/TieInPlanner.java BYTES 2625 SHA256 a0d25fde35687acbd02c080cf996bc32329e9703110a0900ad684a2bd8fd71f7 =====
package com.heatroute.tiein;

import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.linearref.LengthIndexedLine;

public final class TieInPlanner {
  private final Snapshot s;

  public TieInPlanner(Snapshot s) {
    this.s = s;
  }

  public Root at(Coordinate p, Feature chamber) {
    Set<String> incident = new TreeSet<>();
    int degree = 0, dn = 0;
    for (Feature f : s.nearby(new Envelope(p.x - .10, p.x + .10, p.y - .10, p.y + .10))) {
      if (!f.type.equals("heat_network")) continue;
      LineString l = (LineString) f.geometry();
      if (l.distance(Metric.point(p)) <= .10) {
        incident.add(f.key);
        dn = Math.max(dn, f.diameter);
        degree +=
            Math.min(
                        l.getStartPoint().distance(Metric.point(p)),
                        l.getEndPoint().distance(Metric.point(p)))
                    <= .10
                ? 1
                : 2;
      }
    }
    return new Root(p.copy(), chamber, dn, degree, incident);
  }

  public List<Root> candidates(Coordinate target) {
    Map<String, Root> roots = new TreeMap<>();
    List<Feature> lines = new ArrayList<>(s.nearestNetworks(target, 64));
    lines.sort(
        Comparator.comparingDouble((Feature f) -> f.geometry().distance(Metric.point(target)))
            .thenComparing(f -> f.key));
    for (Feature f : lines) {
      LineString l = (LineString) f.geometry();
      LengthIndexedLine indexed = new LengthIndexedLine(l);
      double pos = indexed.project(target);
      for (double at :
          new double[] {
            pos, Math.max(0, pos - 15), Math.min(l.getLength(), pos + 15), 0, l.getLength()
          }) {
        Coordinate p = indexed.extractPoint(at);
        for (Root r : candidatesAt(p)) roots.put(r.key(), r);
      }
    }
    List<Root> list = new ArrayList<>(roots.values());
    list.sort(
        Comparator.comparingDouble((Root r) -> r.point.distance(target)).thenComparing(Root::key));
    return list;
  }

  /** Resolve a proposed point using the same mandatory 10 m chamber rule. */
  public List<Root> candidatesAt(Coordinate p) {
    List<Root> roots = new ArrayList<>();
    for (Feature c : s.chambersNear(p, 10))
      if (c.geometry().getCoordinate().distance(p) <= 10) {
        Root r = at(c.geometry().getCoordinate(), c);
        if (r.degree + 1 <= 4 && !r.incident.isEmpty()) roots.add(r);
      }
    if (roots.isEmpty()) {
      Root r = at(p, null);
      if (r.degree + 1 <= 4 && !r.incident.isEmpty()) roots.add(r);
    }
    return roots;
  }
}

  void importReturnsAuditAndByteFingerprint() throws Exception {

    StringBuilder expected=new StringBuilder();
    for(byte b:java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)) expected.append(String.format("%02x",b));
    var file=new org.springframework.mock.web.MockMultipartFile("file","dataset.geojson","application/geo+json",bytes);
    mvc.perform(multipart("/api/v1/calculations").file(file))
      .andExpect(status().isCreated())

      .andExpect(jsonPath("$.audit.featureCount").value(144))
      .andExpect(jsonPath("$.audit.objectTypes.oks_connection_point").value(17))
      .andExpect(jsonPath("$.inputSha256").value(expected.toString()));
