===== FILE evidence/refined/warm-start-audit/RefineExisting.java BYTES 4764 SHA256 3ac1b944edcbecaef51d8480d5229b0031476783d9ed713a04ff620a17c405a3 =====
package com.heatroute.application;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.export.GeoJsonExporter;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.TreeHydraulics;
import com.heatroute.ingest.GeoJsonInput;
import com.heatroute.tiein.TieInPlanner;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.io.geojson.GeoJsonReader;

/** Scratch audit harness: reconstruct a prior exported star forest and refine it. */
public class RefineExisting {
  static Map<String,List<JsonNode>> outgoing=new TreeMap<>();
  static Map<String,JsonNode> nodes=new TreeMap<>();
  static Snapshot snapshot;
  static Geometry geometry(JsonNode node)throws Exception {
    return Metric.transform(new GeoJsonReader().read(node.get("geometry").toString()),true);
  }
  static class PathResult { String end;LineString line; }
  static PathResult walk(JsonNode first)throws Exception {
    List<Coordinate> points=new ArrayList<>();JsonNode edge=first;String end;
    while(true) {
      Coordinate[] cs=geometry(edge).getCoordinates();
      for(int i=points.isEmpty()?0:1;i<cs.length;i++)points.add(cs[i]);
      end=Model.key(edge.get("properties").get("end_node_id"));
      List<JsonNode> next=outgoing.getOrDefault(end,List.of());
      if(next.size()!=1)break;
      edge=next.get(0);
    }
    PathResult result=new PathResult();result.end=end;result.line=Metric.line(points.toArray(new Coordinate[0]));return result;
  }
  public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception {
    snapshot=new GeoJsonInput().read(Files.newInputStream(Path.of(args[0])));
    JsonNode export=GeoJsonInput.JSON.readTree(Path.of(args[1]).toFile());
    Set<String> incoming=new TreeSet<>();
    for(JsonNode f:export.get("features")) {
      JsonNode p=f.get("properties");if(!p.get("variant_id").asText().equals("v1"))continue;
      String id=Model.key(p.get("id"));nodes.put(id,f);
      if(p.get("object_type").asText().equals("heat_network")) {
        outgoing.computeIfAbsent(Model.key(p.get("start_node_id")),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(f);
        incoming.add(Model.key(p.get("end_node_id")));
      }
    }
    Variant v=new Variant();TieInPlanner planner=new TieInPlanner(snapshot);TreeHydraulics sizing=new TreeHydraulics();
    for(String start:outgoing.keySet())if(!incoming.contains(start)) {
      Feature existing=snapshot.byId.get(start);
      Coordinate coordinate=existing==null?geometry(nodes.get(start)).getCoordinate():existing.geometry().getCoordinate();
      Root root=planner.at(coordinate,existing);
      for(JsonNode edge:outgoing.get(start)) {
        PathResult first=walk(edge);List<Branch> leaves=new ArrayList<>();
        List<JsonNode> forks=outgoing.getOrDefault(first.end,List.of());
        if(forks.isEmpty())leaves.add(new Branch(snapshot.byId.get(first.end),first.line,50));
        else for(JsonNode branch:forks) {
          PathResult leaf=walk(branch);
          if(!outgoing.getOrDefault(leaf.end,List.of()).isEmpty())throw new IllegalStateException("Nested tree unsupported by audit harness");
          leaves.add(new Branch(snapshot.byId.get(leaf.end),leaf.line,50));
        }
        v.components.add(sizing.size(root,forks.isEmpty()?null:first.line.getEndPoint().getCoordinate(),forks.isEmpty()?null:first.line,leaves));
      }
    }
    Set<String> assigned=new TreeSet<>();for(Component c:v.components)for(Branch b:c.branches)assigned.add(b.target.key);
    for(Feature f:snapshot.targets)if(!assigned.contains(f.key))v.missing.add(f);
    Optimizer optimizer=new Optimizer(snapshot,p->System.out.println(p));optimizer.score(v);
    new SolutionVerifier(snapshot).verify(v);
    System.out.println("IMPORTED cost="+v.construction()+" length="+v.length+" score="+v.score);
    Map<LineString,String> originalLines=new IdentityHashMap<>();
    for(Component c:v.components)for(LineString line:Optimizer.lines(c))originalLines.put(line,line.toText());
    var report=new NetworkRefiner(snapshot,optimizer,p->System.out.println(p)).refine(v,1);
    for(var entry:originalLines.entrySet())if(!entry.getValue().equals(entry.getKey().toText()))
      throw new IllegalStateException("Refinement mutated a source route");
    System.out.println("PASS: original route geometries unchanged; refinement monotone and coverage preserved");
    Path dest=Path.of(args[2]);Files.createDirectories(dest);
    new GeoJsonExporter().write(snapshot,List.of(v),Files.newOutputStream(dest.resolve("result.geojson")));
    GeoJsonInput.JSON.writerWithDefaultPrettyPrinter().writeValue(dest.resolve("refinement.json").toFile(),report);
    System.out.println(report);snapshot.close();
  }
}

package com.heatroute.application;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.node.TextNode;
import com.heatroute.domain.Model.*;
import com.heatroute.geo.Metric;
import com.heatroute.hydraulic.TreeHydraulics;
import com.heatroute.tiein.TieInPlanner;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.*;
import org.locationtech.jts.geom.*;

/** Independent small case: shorten a legal detour, reuse the chamber, preserve source geometry. */
public class RefinementFixture {
  static Coordinate p(double x,double y){return new Coordinate(x,y);}
  static Feature f(String id,String type,String restriction,Geometry g,int dn,String flow){
    return new Feature(TextNode.valueOf(id),type,restriction,g,dn,new BigDecimal(flow));
  }
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    Feature network=f("main","heat_network","",Metric.line(p(0,-100),p(0,100)),300,"0");
    Feature chamber=f("existing","heat_chamber","",Metric.point(p(0,0)),300,"0");
    Feature target=f("target","oks_connection_point","",Metric.point(p(80,0)),0,"1");
    Feature house=f("house","restriction","oks",Metric.GF.createPolygon(new Coordinate[]{p(75,-5),p(85,-5),p(85,5),p(75,5),p(75,-5)}),0,"0");
    Snapshot snapshot=new Snapshot(List.of(network,chamber,target,house));
    Root root=new TieInPlanner(snapshot).at(p(0,50),null);
    LineString original=Metric.line(p(0,50),p(60,50),p(60,0),p(80,0));
    String oldGeometry=original.toText();
    Variant v=new Variant();v.components.add(new TreeHydraulics().size(root,null,null,List.of(new Branch(target,original,50))));
    Optimizer optimizer=new Optimizer(snapshot,x->{});optimizer.score(v);BigDecimal before=v.score;
    new SolutionVerifier(snapshot).verify(v);
    new NetworkRefiner(snapshot,optimizer,x->{}).refine(v,1);
    if(!original.toText().equals(oldGeometry))throw new AssertionError("Source geometry mutated");
    if(v.components.size()!=1||v.components.get(0).branches.size()!=1||!v.missing.isEmpty())throw new AssertionError("Coverage changed");
    if(v.score.compareTo(before)>=0)throw new AssertionError("Detour not improved");
    if(v.components.get(0).root.existingChamber!=chamber)throw new AssertionError("10 m chamber reuse rule not applied");
    if(Math.abs(v.length.doubleValue()-80)>1e-6)throw new AssertionError("Fixture's known shortest 80 m route not found");
    new SolutionVerifier(snapshot).verify(v);
    System.out.println("PASS: known 80 m optimum; existing chamber reused; source immutable; coverage, geometry, sizing and score verified");
  }
}

===== FILE scripts/bundle.py BYTES 1857 SHA256 610a45806bcfbc0fd983e7ad86fc525af73e3b91f8bde34e9735ff81245cc8e2 =====
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Rebuild source listing, checksums and ZIP without build caches or user jobs."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,zipfile
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
excluded={'target','optimus-data','.git','__pycache__','backups'}
def members():
    return sorted(p for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not set(p.relative_to(root).parts)&excluded and p.name not in {'full-project.txt','SHA256SUMS','.env'} and (not p.name.startswith('.env.') or p.name=='.env.example'))
listing=root/'full-project.txt'
with listing.open('wb') as out:
    out.write('OPTIMUS HeatRoute 2.1 — полное содержимое текстовых файлов\nВосстановление: python3 scripts/restore.py full-project.txt destination\nБинарные файлы поставляются в архиве отдельно.\n\n'.encode('utf-8'))
    for p in members():
        if p.suffix.lower() in {'.jar','.gz','.pdf','.docx','.png','.zip'}:continue
        raw=p.read_bytes()
        try:raw.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:continue
        rel=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        sha=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        out.write(f'===== FILE {rel} BYTES {len(raw)} SHA256 {sha} =====\n'.encode('utf-8'))
        out.write(raw)
        out.write(f'\n===== END FILE {rel} =====\n\n'.encode('utf-8'))
files=members()+[listing]
(root/'SHA256SUMS').write_text(''.join(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+'  '+p.relative_to(root).as_posix()+'\n' for p in files),encoding='utf-8')
archive=root.parent/'OPTIMUS-HeatRoute-Final.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as z:
    for p in sorted(files+[root/'SHA256SUMS']):z.write(p,'OPTIMUS-HeatRoute/'+p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
print(archive);print(archive.stat().st_size,'bytes;',len(files)+1,'files')

===== END FILE scripts/bundle.py =====

"""

"""WGS84 to UTM 37N map coordinates (screen Y increases south)."""
import math
def utm(c):
 lon,lat=map(math.radians,c[:2]);e=.0066943799901413165;ep=e/(1-e);A=math.cos(lat)*(lon-math.radians(39));t=math.tan(lat)**2;C=ep*math.cos(lat)**2;N=6378137/math.sqrt(1-e*math.sin(lat)**2)
 M=6378137*((1-e/4-3*e**2/64-5*e**3/256)*lat-(3*e/8+3*e**2/32+45*e**3/1024)*math.sin(2*lat)+(15*e**2/256+45*e**3/1024)*math.sin(4*lat)-35*e**3/3072*math.sin(6*lat))
 return (500000+.9996*N*(A+(1-t+C)*A**3/6+(5-18*t+t*t+72*C-58*ep)*A**5/120),-.9996*(M+N*math.tan(lat)*(A*A/2+(5-t+9*C+4*C*C)*A**4/24+(61-58*t+t*t+600*C-330*ep)*A**6/720)))
def coords(g):
 v=g['coordinates']
 def walk(x):
  if isinstance(x[0],(int,float)):yield utm(x)
  else:
   for y in x:yield from walk(y)
 return list(walk(v))
def bounds(features,pad=20):
 c=[c for f in features if f['geometry'] for c in coords(f['geometry'])];xs,ys=zip(*c);return [min(xs)-pad,min(ys)-pad,max(xs)-min(xs)+2*pad,max(ys)-min(ys)+2*pad]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independently verify selected entries against every polygon boundary segment."""
import json,math,re,sys
from map_geometry import utm
source=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); report=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]));report=report.get('report',report)
assert report['entryPolicy']=='nearest'
byid={str(f['properties']['id']):f for f in source['features']}
def distance(p,a,b):
 dx,dy=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1];den=dx*dx+dy*dy
 t=max(0,min(1,((p[0]-a[0])*dx+(p[1]-a[1])*dy)/den)) if den else 0
 return math.hypot(p[0]-a[0]-t*dx,p[1]-a[1]-t*dy)
checked=0;max_error=0
for d in report['targetDiagnostics']:
 if d['status']!='CONNECTED' or not d.get('ownBuildingId'):continue
 p=utm(byid[str(d['targetId'])]['geometry']['coordinates']);g=byid[str(d['ownBuildingId'])]['geometry'];polys=[g['coordinates']] if g['type']=='Polygon' else g['coordinates']
 segments=[(utm(a),utm(b)) for poly in polys for ring in poly for a,b in zip(ring,ring[1:])]
 minimum=min(distance(p,a,b) for a,b in segments)
 entry=utm(list(map(float,re.findall(r'[-+]?\d*\.?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?',d['selectedEntryWgs84'])[:2])))
 error=abs(math.dist(p,entry)-minimum);on_boundary=min(distance(entry,a,b) for a,b in segments)
 assert error<.001 and on_boundary<.001,(d['targetId'],error,on_boundary)
 checked+=1;max_error=max(max_error,error,on_boundary)
print(json.dumps({'entryPolicy':'nearest','connectedEntriesChecked':checked,'maximumErrorM':max_error,'toleranceM':.001,'status':'PASS'},indent=2))
